youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Hot Spring Bath
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的泡溫泉情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從買票領兩條毛巾（一個大人四百五十元，兩張票九百）、在更衣室找到櫃子先把身體沖乾淨、毛巾絕對不能進水、問每一池幾度（大池四十二度、氣泡池四十度、戶外岩石池、另一邊廳的溫水池三十六度）、泡到頭暈要靠著牆按鈴、上岸喝一瓶牛奶（一瓶六十、四瓶兩百四）、被問到手臂上的刺青要不要蓋、換到另一邊的池子、決定留下來住一晚（一人兩千六、含兩餐、已刷四千三）、借浴衣在休息廳吃溫泉蛋和紅豆湯（共三百二十、加浴衣一百、零花六百六），一直到睡前再泡五分鐘、十點關門、六點五十敲門、七點早餐、十點退房、十點半的客運回家，不用背，睡前聽就會。一整天熱水三輪四十五分鐘、晚上再加五分鐘。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #泡溫泉
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Hot Spring Bath phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue) — two travelers buy day tickets at four hundred fifty each, take the two small towels, find a locker, rinse clean before getting in, keep the towel out of the water, ask what temperature each pool is, sit down and ring the bell when the heat makes them dizzy, drink a bottle of milk by the window, answer questions about a tattoo, try the warm pool in the other hall, decide to stay the night, wear robes over snacks in the lounge, and take one last five minute soak before the baths close at ten. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it before ten o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi meɪd ɪt bɪˈfɔr tɛn əˈklɑk./
dialogue.zh: 我們十點以前到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus was slower than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs wəz ˈsloʊər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 公車比我以為的還慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This building looks like an old hotel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ lʊks laɪk ən ˈoʊld hoʊˌtɛl./
dialogue.zh: 這棟建築看起來像間老飯店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My grandfather came here as a boy.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈɡrænˌfɑðər keɪm hɪr æz ə bɔɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我小時候我爺爺就來過這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water smells like boiled eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər smɛlz laɪk bɔld ɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水聞起來像煮熟的雞蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the sulfur, it is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsʌlfər ɪt ɪz ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 那是硫磺味，很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we buy the tickets?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi baɪ ðə ˈtɪkəts?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要在哪裡買票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The counter is on your left, near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkaʊntər ɪz ɑn jɔr lɛft nɪr ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯在你左手邊，就在門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four hundred fifty for one adult.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti fɔr wʌn əˈdʌlt./
dialogue.zh: 一個大人四百五十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that only the bath, or everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈoʊnli ðə bæθ ɔr ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 那只是泡湯的錢，還是全部包含？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It covers the bath and two towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkʌvərz ðə bæθ ænd tu ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 包含泡湯和兩條毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two towels means one big and one small.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈtaʊəlz minz wʌn bɪɡ ænd wʌn smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 兩條毛巾就是一條大的、一條小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids pay the same as adults?
dialogue.phonetic: /du kɪdz peɪ ðə seɪm æz əˈdʌlts?/
dialogue.zh: 小孩跟大人的收費一樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a child ticket is two hundred fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə tʃaɪld ˈtɪkət ɪz tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɪfti./
dialogue.zh: 不一樣，兒童票是兩百五十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take cards at this counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju teɪk kɑrdz æt ðɪs ˈkaʊntər./
dialogue.zh: 這個櫃檯可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, cash works and the card works too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr kæʃ wɜrks ænd ðə kɑrd wɜrks tu./
dialogue.zh: 當然，付現金也可以，刷卡也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want a paper receipt, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ə ˈpeɪpər rɪˈsit pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請給我一張紙本的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is your receipt, keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz jɔr rɪˈsit kip ɪt seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 收據在這裡，收好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady says our towels are inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi sɛz ˈaʊər ˈtaʊəlz ɑr ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯小姐說我們的毛巾在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the blue basket, right by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə blu ˈbæskət raɪt baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在門邊的藍色籃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One big towel and one small towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ ˈtaʊəl ænd wʌn smɔl ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 一條大毛巾，一條小毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one goes on your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌn ɡoʊz ɑn jɔr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 小毛巾是要蓋在頭上的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do people put it on the head?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ˈpipəl pʊt ɪt ɑn ðə hɛd?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼大家都把它放頭上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps your face cool in the steam.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips jɔr feɪs kul ɪn ðə stim./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣很悶的時候，它可以讓臉涼一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I rent a bigger towel here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɛnt ə ˈbɪɡər ˈtaʊəl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡租一條更大的毛巾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can, it is eighty for one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ɪt ɪz ˈeɪti fɔr wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 可以，一條八十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighty back when we return it, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈægti bæk wɛn wi rɪˈtɜrn ɪt raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 還毛巾的時候八十元會退回來，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so we will keep our two towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ wi wɪl kip ˈaʊər tu ˈtaʊəlz./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以我們還是用原本的兩條就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, these paper tags are for lockers.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðiz ˈpeɪpər tæɡz ɑr fɔr ˈlɑkərz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，這些紙牌是更衣櫃的號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the blue tag, I will take red.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə blu tæɡ aɪ wɪl teɪk rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 你拿藍色那張，我拿紅色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoes go in this little box.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃuz ɡoʊ ɪn ðɪs ˈlɪtəl bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 我的鞋子放這個小格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the slippers come with you inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈslɪpərz kʌm wɪð ju ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 室內拖鞋要一起帶進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the floor cold in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə flɔr koʊld ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的地板冰嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very cold, so walk slow and do not run.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri koʊld soʊ wɔk sloʊ ænd du nɑt rʌn./
dialogue.zh: 地板很冰，所以要走慢一點，別跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we rinse before the bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi rɪns bɪˈfɔr ðə bæθ?/
dialogue.zh: 下水之前要在哪裡先沖乾淨？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the taps, before the big pool door.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə tæps bɪˈfɔr ðə bɪɡ pul dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 在大池門前面的水龍頭那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read this sign with me, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðɪs saɪn wɪð mi pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請跟我一起讀這個牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First line: wash your body first.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst laɪn wɔʃ jɔr ˈbɑdi fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 第一行：先把身體洗乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second line: no towel in the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd laɪn noʊ ˈtaʊəl ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 第二行：毛巾不可以進水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard that, it keeps the pool clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ðæt ɪt kips ðə pul klin./
dialogue.zh: 我聽過這條，這樣水池才乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Third line says: no swimming, no jumping.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd laɪn sɛz noʊ ˈswɪmɪŋ noʊ ˈdʒʌmpɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 第三行寫：不可以游泳、不可以跳水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids love to splash, so watch them well.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz lʌv tu splæʃ soʊ wɑtʃ ðɛm wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 小孩最喜歡潑水，所以要看好他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can one soak last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ kæn wʌn soʊk læst?/
dialogue.zh: 一次最多可以泡多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes in the hot pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts ɪn ðə hɑt pul./
dialogue.zh: 熱水池裡十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen, and then we get out to rest?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ænd ðɛn wi ɡɛt aʊt tu rɛst?/
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘後就要起來休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, rest about twenty minutes between rounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs rɛst əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts bɪˈtwin raʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 對，兩輪之間休息大約二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So three rounds today, forty five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ θri raʊndz təˈdeɪ ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 所以今天泡三輪，一共四十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the plan, and no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə plæn ænd noʊ mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 就照這個計畫，不要再多泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why only three rounds, is it bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ˈoʊnli θri raʊndz ɪz ɪt bæd?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼只泡三輪，會不舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too much hot water makes you weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ hɑt ˈwɔtər meɪks ju wik./
dialogue.zh: 泡太多熱水，會讓整個人都發軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any rule about eating before the bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni rul əˈbaʊt ˈitɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə bæθ?/
dialogue.zh: 吃飯跟泡湯之間有什麼規定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not soak right after a full meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt soʊk raɪt ˈæftər ə fʊl mil./
dialogue.zh: 吃得很飽的時候不要馬上泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we eat later, after the last round.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi it ˈleɪtər ˈæftər ðə læst raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 那我們就在最後一輪泡完之後再吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lunch room opens at eleven thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lʌntʃ rum ˈoʊpənz æt əˈlɛvən ˈθɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 用餐區十一點半開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we take a photo in the pool?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪn ðə pul?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在池邊拍照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No photos at all, phones stay locked away.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈfoʊtoʊz ɑt ɔl foʊnz steɪ lɑkt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 完全不行，手機要鎖在櫃子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is heavy, is the locker big?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz ˈhɛvi ɪz ðə ˈlɑkər bɪɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的背包很重，櫃子夠大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enough for two bags and one jacket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪˈnʌf fɔr tu bæɡz ænd wʌn ˈdʒækət./
dialogue.zh: 放兩個包和一件外套還夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the tattoo on my arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə tæˈtu ɑn maɪ ɑrm?/
dialogue.zh: 那我手臂上的刺青怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show the lady first, she decides today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ ðə ˈleɪdi fɜrst ʃi dɪˈsaɪdz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 先給櫃檯小姐看，今天由她決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She looked at it and said nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi lʊkt æt ɪt ænd sɛd ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她看了一下，什麼都沒說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it is small enough, go on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt ɪz smɔl ɪˈnʌf ɡoʊ ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 那就代表面積夠小，可以進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, your watch says nine twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt jɔr wɑtʃ sɛz naɪn ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 等等，你的手錶顯示九點二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good time, the pools are quiet now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd taɪm ðə pulz ɑr ˈkwaɪət naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 時間剛好，這個時候池子很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free water is here, take a cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈwɔtər ɪz hɪr teɪk ə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 免費的飲水在這裡，倒一杯吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cups are there, above the tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌps ɑr ðɛr əˈbʌv ðə tæp./
dialogue.zh: 杯子在那邊，水龍頭上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need the toilet before all this.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ðə ˈtɔɪlət bɪˈfɔr ɔl ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這一切之前我想先去洗手間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall, past the cold water tap.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə hɔl pæst ðə koʊld ˈwɔtər tæp./
dialogue.zh: 沿著走廊走，經過冷水水龍頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is the map of all four pools.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ðə mæp əv ɔl fɔr pulz./
dialogue.zh: 這是四個池子的配置圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one, the bubble one, and two small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn ðə ˈbʌbəl wʌn ænd tu smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 大池、氣泡池，還有兩個小池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cold pool is only for the feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn koʊld pul ɪz ˈoʊnli fɔr ðə fit./
dialogue.zh: 有一個冷水池是專門泡腳的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool your arms before you get in.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul jɔr ɑrmz bɪˈfɔr ju ɡɛt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 下水之前先讓手臂適應涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the outdoor pool is across the garden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ˈaʊtˌdɔr pul ɪz əˈkrɔs ðə ˈɡɑrdən./
dialogue.zh: 露天那個池子在花園另一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We go there later, that one is cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡoʊ ðɛr ˈleɪtər ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈkulər./
dialogue.zh: 我們等等再去，那個比較涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock on the wall is easy to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk ɑn ðə wɔl ɪz ˈizi tu si./
dialogue.zh: 牆上那座鐘很好看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, then I can count fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɛkt ðɛn aɪ kæn kaʊnt ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我就能算十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to tie my hair back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu taɪ maɪ hɛr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮要先綁起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, long hair goes under the small towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lɔŋ hɛr ɡoʊz ˈʌndər ðə smɔl ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 要，長頭髮都收在小毛巾下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have no hair band with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv noʊ hɛr bænd wɪð mi./
dialogue.zh: 我身上沒有帶髮圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use this green one, I have two.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðɪs ɡrin wʌn aɪ hæv tu./
dialogue.zh: 用我這條綠的，我有兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take off your watch and your glasses.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɑf jɔr wɑtʃ ænd jɔr ˈɡlæsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 手錶和眼鏡都先摘下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steam covers the glasses right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim ˈkʌvərz ðə ˈɡlæsɪz raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 蒸氣一下就把眼鏡霧住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the main pool very hot today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə meɪn pul ˈvɛri hɑt təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天大池的水很燙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty two, that is the posted number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ðæt ɪz ðə ˈpoʊstəd ˈnʌmbər./
dialogue.zh: 四十二度，牌子上就是寫這個數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty two, and how deep is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ænd haʊ dip ɪz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 四十二度，那水深到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waist deep for me, maybe chest deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪst dip fɔr mi ˈmeɪbi tʃɛst dip./
dialogue.zh: 到我腰這裡，也許到胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we put our wet clothes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi pʊt ˈaʊər wɛt kloʊz?/
dialogue.zh: 換下來的濕衣服要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In this plastic bag, we take it home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðɪs ˈplæstək bæɡ wi teɪk ɪt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 放這個塑膠袋，最後帶回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pass with lunch costs more, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pæs wɪð lʌntʃ kɔsts mɔr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 含午餐的套票比較貴，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds a hundred for the meal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ædz ə ˈhʌndrəd fɔr ðə mil./
dialogue.zh: 含餐點的話，一個人要再加一百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Skip the meal, two tickets, nine hundred.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ðə mil tu ˈtɪkəts naɪn ˈhʌndrəd./
dialogue.zh: 餐點就不加了，兩張票九百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I paid by card, here is your ticket.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ peɪd baɪ kɑrd hɪr ɪz jɔr ˈtɪkət./
dialogue.zh: 我用卡付了，這張是你的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start with the smaller pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈsmɔlər pul./
dialogue.zh: 我們先從小一點的池子開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever, then the hot one feels fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvər ðɛn ðə hɑt wʌn filz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，這樣熱水池就不會那麼可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am a little scared of the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ə ˈlɪtəl skɛrd əv ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 我有點怕那個溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put only your feet in first.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ˈoʊnli jɔr fits ɪn fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 先只把腳伸進去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay here the whole day?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi steɪ hɪr ðə hoʊl deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這裡待一整天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This place closes late, at ten tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs ˈkloʊzɪz leɪt æt tɛn təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這裡今晚十點才關門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is the last time to come in.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪz ðə læst taɪm tu kʌm ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 九點是最後進場的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we have all day for three rounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd wi hæv ɔl deɪ fɔr θri raʊndz./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們整天都可以泡三輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The changing room is full today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtʃeɪndʒɪŋ rum ɪz fʊl təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天更衣室裡好多人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people come before ten in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈpipəl kʌm bɪˈfɔr tɛn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 大部分的人都是早上十點以前來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Find your locker, the blue paper tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd jɔr ˈlɑkər ðə blu ˈpeɪpər tæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 找你的櫃子，藍色那個紙牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine is by the window, yours is next.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ɪz baɪ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ jɔrz ɪz nɛkst./
dialogue.zh: 我的在窗邊，你的就在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold my shirt on this clean shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld maɪ ʃɜrt ɑn ðɪs klin ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 我的上衣摺好放在這個乾淨的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And put your pants in the small drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd pʊt jɔr pænts ɪn ðə smɔl drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 褲子放那個小抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take off my necklace too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ teɪk ɑf maɪ ˈnɛkˌlɛs tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我的項鏈也要一起摘下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, hot water loosens all jewelry.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs hɑt ˈwɔtər ˈlusənz ɔl ˈdʒuːəlri./
dialogue.zh: 要，熱水會讓首飾變鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rings and watch go in this tiny box.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋz ænd wɑtʃ ɡoʊ ɪn ðɪs ˈtaɪni bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 戒指和手錶放這個小盒子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lock it, the key stays with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑk ɪt ðə ki steɪz wɪð ju./
dialogue.zh: 鎖起來，鑰匙你自己帶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those old ladies always here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðoʊz ˈoʊld ˈleɪdiz ˈɔlweɪz hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 那幾位阿嬤每天早上都在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every morning, they have been coming for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈmɔrnɪŋ ðeɪ hæv bɪn ˈkʌmɪŋ fɔr jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 每天早上都有，他們來了好幾十年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we sit to wash?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi sɪt tu wɑʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要坐在哪裡洗澡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On these low stools, in front of the taps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðiz loʊ stulz ɪn frʌnt əv ðə tæps./
dialogue.zh: 坐這些矮板凳，在水龍頭前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small bucket and one cup each.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl ˈbʌkət ænd wʌn kʌp itʃ./
dialogue.zh: 一人一個小桶子、一個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill it with warm water, not the hot one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl ɪt wɪð wɔrm ˈwɔtər nɑt ðə hɑt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 裝溫的水，別裝最燙那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First I pour water on my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst aɪ pɔr ˈwɔtər ɑn maɪ fits./
dialogue.zh: 我先把水沖在腳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then your arms, so heat is not a shock.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɔr ɑrmz soʊ hit ɪz nɑt ə ʃɑk./
dialogue.zh: 然後沖手臂，熱水才不會嚇到身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit down before you stand up again.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn bɪˈfɔr ju stænd ʌp əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 站起來之前先坐好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The floor is slippery, I know that now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz ˈslɪpəri aɪ noʊ ðæt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 地板很濕滑，我現在知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This soap is in a paper wrapper.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs soʊp ɪz ɪn ə ˈpeɪpər ˈræpər./
dialogue.zh: 這塊肥皂包在紙裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the paper, the soap gets soft fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈpeɪpər ðə soʊp ɡɛts sɔft fæst./
dialogue.zh: 紙留著，肥皂泡一下就很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my own shampoo?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ ˈoʊn ʃæmˈpu?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要自己帶洗髮精嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a bottle here, free for guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈbɑtəl hɪr fri fɔr ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 這裡就有瓶子，客人免費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bottles, one for hair, one for body.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑtəlz wʌn fɔr hɛr wʌn fɔr ˈbɑdi./
dialogue.zh: 兩瓶，一瓶洗頭，一瓶洗身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the top, only a little comes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə tɑp ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl kʌmz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 壓一下蓋子，出來量很少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wash your neck and behind the ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ jɔr nɛk ænd bɪˈhaɪnd ði ɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 搓一下你的脖子和耳朵後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody sees those, but they get dirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi siz ðoz bʌt ðeɪ ɡɛt ˈdɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 沒人會看那裡，可是最容易髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elbows and ankles are always missed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛlˌboʊz ænd ˈæŋkəlz ɑr ˈɔlweɪz mɪst./
dialogue.zh: 手肘和腳踝常常被忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrub them, the water here feels softer.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrʌb ðɛm ðə ˈwɔtər hɪr filz ˈsɔfər./
dialogue.zh: 搓一搓，這裡的水摸起來比較柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Between the toes, my feet itch now.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtin ðə toʊz maɪ fits ɪtʃ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 腳趾中間，我的腳現在好癢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, warm water stops the itch.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu wɔrm ˈwɔtər stɑps ði ɪtʃ./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，溫水泡一下就不癢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use the soap in the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt juz ðə soʊp ɪn ðə pul./
dialogue.zh: 不要在池子裡用肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course not, rinse it all off first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs nɑt rɪns ɪt ɔl ɑf fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 當然不了，先全部沖乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Foam in the water makes everyone angry.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊm ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər meɪks ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈæŋɡri./
dialogue.zh: 水裡有泡沫會讓大家生氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the staff has to change the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə stæf hæz tu tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 而且工作人員就得換水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get foam off my back?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt foʊm ɑf maɪ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 我背上的泡沫要怎麼清掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use this long cloth, reach around once.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðɪs lɔŋ klɔθ ritʃ əˈraʊnd wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 用這條長布，繞過去擦一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The washcloth feels rough and nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɑʃˌklɔθ filz rʌf ænd naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 這塊洗澡布粗粗的，很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the best one for your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə bɛst wʌn fɔr jɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 這塊布拿來擦背最方便了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse once, twice, then look at your arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns wʌns taɪs ðɛn lʊk æt jɔr ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 沖一次、兩次，然後看看你的手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more slippery soap, I can feel it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr ˈslɪpəri soʊp aɪ kæn fil ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有肥皂的滑感了，我感覺得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my hair, I wet it with the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ hɛr aɪ wɛt ɪt wɪð ðə kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 現在換頭髮，我用杯子把它弄濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt your head back, keep your eyes shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪlt jɔr hɛd bæk kip jɔr aɪz ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 頭往後仰，眼睛閉起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shampoo runs down my neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃæmˈpu rʌnz daʊn maɪ nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 洗髮精順著我脖子流下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour slowly from the top of your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ˈsloʊli frʌm ðə tɑp əv jɔr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 從頭頂慢慢倒下去就行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rinse with cold water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ rɪns wɪð koʊld ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我要用涼的水沖頭髮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cold makes the hair lie flat again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs koʊld meɪks ðə hɛr laɪ flæt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 要，涼水會讓頭髮服貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hair dripping everywhere, use the towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr ˈdrɪpɪŋ ˈɛvriˌwɛrz juz ðə ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 頭髮到處滴水，用毛巾擦一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Squeeze it, do not rub the skin hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /swiz ɪt du nɑt rʌb ðə skɪn hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 輕輕擰乾就好，別用力搓皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tie the wet hair up on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ðə wɛt hɛr ˈʌp ɑn tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 把濕頭髮盤到頭頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The band holds it, nothing falls in the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bænd hoʊldz ɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ fɔlz ɪn ðə pul./
dialogue.zh: 髮圈會抓住，不會掉進池子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I put this wet cloth?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pʊt ðɪs wɛt klɔθ?/
dialogue.zh: 這塊濕的洗澡布要放哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the wooden rack, it dries by itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə ˈwʊdən ræk ɪt draɪz baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 放在木架上，它自己就會乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some people leave theirs on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpipəl liv ðɛrz ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有些人的布就直接留在地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The staff picks them up, every single time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stæf pɪks ðɛm ʌp ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 工作人員每一次都要彎腰撿起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see that man with no towel?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si ðæt mæn wɪð noʊ ˈtaʊəl?/
dialogue.zh: 你有看到那個沒帶毛巾的先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He uses his hands, it looks so awkward.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈjuzɪz hɪz hændz ɪt lʊks soʊ ˈɔkwərd./
dialogue.zh: 他用手捧水，看起來很不好意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I clean enough now, do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ klin ɪˈnʌf naʊ du ju θɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在算洗乾淨了嗎，妳覺得呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your feet, then we can walk in.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk jɔr fits ðɛn wi kæn wɔk ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 再看一眼腳，然後我們就能進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a mirror by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə ˈmɪrər baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門邊有一面鏡子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, my hair still has a wet spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd maɪ hɛr stɪl hæz ə wɛt spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 還好，我頭髮還有一塊是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before the pool, pour on your shoulders.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr ðə pul pɔr ɑn jɔr ˈʃoʊldərz./
dialogue.zh: 下水之前，先澆肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three times, and say nothing while you do it.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri taɪmz ænd seɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ waɪl ju du ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 澆三次，做的時候不要說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water sounds heavy on my skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔtər saʊndz ˈhɛvi ɑn maɪ skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 水打在皮膚上聲音好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wakes the body up before the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪks ðə ˈbɑdi ʌp bɪˈfɔr ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 燙水之前身體先被叫醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My chest feels tight, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tʃɛst filz taɪt ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl?/
dialogue.zh: 我胸口有點緊，這正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out slowly, do not hold your breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið aʊt ˈsloʊli du nɑt hoʊld jɔr brɛθ./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢吐氣，不要憋著呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This white board says keep quiet here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs waɪt bɔrd sɛz kip ˈkwaɪət hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這塊白板寫著這裡要安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: People come to rest, not to talk loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpipəl kʌm tu rɛst nɑt tu tɔk laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 大家是來休息的，不是來大聲聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step down slowly, the tile is slick.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp daʊn ˈsloʊli ðə taɪl ɪz slɪk./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢踩下去，磁磚很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the rail with one hand, then the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə reɪl wɪð wʌn hænd ðɛn ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 一手扶著欄杆，另一手才碰水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The steam is thicker inside the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stim ɪz ˈθɪkər ɪnˈsaɪd ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 門裡面的蒸氣更濃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slow, the steam tastes like eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið sloʊ ðə stim teɪsts laɪk ɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢呼吸，蒸氣的味道像雞蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine forty on the wall clock now.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈfɔrti ɑn ðə wɔl klɑk naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 牆上的鐘現在是九點四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we stop at nine fifty five.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi stɑp æt naɪn ˈfɪfti faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們九點五十五要上岸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only my feet, then my legs in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli maɪ fits ðɛn maɪ lɛɡz ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 先進腳，再慢慢放小腿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down in the water, take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn ɪn ðə ˈwɔtər teɪk jɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 坐在水裡，不用急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty two is hot for my knees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ɪz hɑt fɔr maɪ niz./
dialogue.zh: 四十二度對我的膝蓋來說很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait ten seconds, then go in to the waist.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tɛn ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn ɡoʊ ɪn tu ðə weɪst./
dialogue.zh: 等十秒，再泡到腰這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My back is already sweating in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈswɛtɪŋ ɪn hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 才進來我背上就已經流汗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it is working, drink some water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ drɪŋk sʌm ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 代表開始起作用了，喝點水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I slide under the water?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ slaɪd ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以整個人滑到水面下面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep your face above it always.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip jɔr feɪs əˈbʌv ɪt ˈɔlweɪz./
dialogue.zh: 不行，臉要一直留在水面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody swims, everybody just sits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊˌbɑdi swɪmz ˈɛvriˌbɑdi dʒʌst sɪts./
dialogue.zh: 沒人游泳，大家都只是坐著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eyes closed, some of them are asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪz kloʊzd sʌm əv ðɛm ɑr əˈslip./
dialogue.zh: 眼睛閉著，有好幾個其實睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear water and nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ˈwɔtər ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 我只聽得水聲，沒有別的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is where people come to think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz wɛr ˈpipəl kʌm tu θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 大家就是來這裡想事情的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers look soft and wrinkled.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz lʊk sɔft ænd ˈrɪŋkəld./
dialogue.zh: 我的手指看起來軟軟皺皺的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it ten minutes, then we get out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tɛn ˈmɪnəts ðɛn wi ɡɛt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 再十分鐘，然後我們就要起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock says nine forty eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk sɛz naɪn ˈfɔrti eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鐘上顯示九點四十八。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven minutes left, then we rest a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈmɪnəts lɛft ðɛn wi rɛst ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 還剩七分鐘，上岸之後要去休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I put my head under?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊt maɪ hɛd ˈʌndər?/
dialogue.zh: 我要把頭也浸進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep the small towel on your head.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kip ðə smɔl ˈtaʊəl ɑn jɔr hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 不要，小毛巾繼續蓋在頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My heart beats fast in this heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɑrt bits fæst ɪn ðɪs hit./
dialogue.zh: 這麼熱，我的心跳變很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell me if it feels too much, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ɪf ɪt filz tu mʌtʃ oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 覺得太超過就跟我說，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am fine, just warm and heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm faɪn dʒʌst wɔrm ænd ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 我沒事，只是整個人都暖到發沉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we rest first, and milk after that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi rɛst fɜrst ænd mɪlk ˈæftər ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 那我們先休息，之後再喝牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five more minutes, that is my last.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv mɔr ˈmɪnəts ðæt ɪz maɪ læst./
dialogue.zh: 再五分鐘，那已經是我最後的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine fifty five, out you go, on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈfɪfti faɪv aʊt ju ɡoʊ ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 九點五十五，準時上岸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out we go, wipe your feet first.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt wi ɡoʊ waɪp jɔr fits fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我們上岸，先把腳擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mat is right by the pool door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæt ɪz raɪt baɪ ðə pul dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 防滑墊就在池門旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now, about the heat of the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ əˈbaʊt ðə hit əv ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 現在來說說水溫這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a small board on each pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə smɔl bɔrd ɑn itʃ pul./
dialogue.zh: 每個池子都有一塊小牌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This board says forty two for the big one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɔrd sɛz ˈfɔrti tu fɔr ðə bɪɡ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 這塊牌子寫大池四十二度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bubble pool is forty, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌbəl pul ɪz ˈfɔrti raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 氣泡池是四十度，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which of these pools is the hottest?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ əv ðiz pulz ɪz ðə ˈhɑtəst?/
dialogue.zh: 這幾個池子哪個最燙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big one, then bubbles, then the small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ wʌn ðɛn ˈbʌbəlz ðɛn ðə smɔl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 大池最燙，然後氣泡池，再來是小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is forty two hotter than a home bath?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈfɔrti tu ˈhɑtər ðæn ə hoʊm bæθ?/
dialogue.zh: 四十二度比在家洗澡燙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home water is around thirty eight or so.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊm ˈwɔtər ɪz əˈraʊnd ˈθɜrti eɪt ɔr soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 家裡的熱水大約三十八度左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty seven is the temperature of my body.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti ˈsɛvən ɪz ðə ˈtɛmprətʃər əv maɪ ˈbɑdi./
dialogue.zh: 三十七度是我身體的溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So forty two feels five degrees hotter.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈfɔrti tu filz faɪv dɪˈɡriz ˈhɑtər./
dialogue.zh: 所以四十二度感覺多了五度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the man washing the floor over there.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə mæn ˈwɑʃɪŋ ðə flɔr ˈoʊvɚ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 去問那邊那位洗地板的先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has worked here since I was small.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz wɜrkt hɪr sɪns aɪ wəz smɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我小時候他就已經在這裡工作了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how hot is the small pool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi haʊ hɑt ɪz ðə smɔl pul?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，那個小池多熱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says thirty eight, it is the soft one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ˈθɜrti eɪt ɪt ɪz ðə sɔft wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 他說三十八度，那個最溫和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty eight, that sounds perfect to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti eɪt ðæt saʊndz ˈpɜrfɪkt tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 三十八度，我覺得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the bubbles first, they are forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈbʌbəlz fɜrst ðeɪ ɑr ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 先試氣泡池，那個是四十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty with moving water feels hotter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti wɪð ˈmʊvɪŋ ˈwɔtər filz ˈhɑtər./
dialogue.zh: 四十度可是水一直在動，感覺更燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the jets push air up in bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə dʒɛts pʊʃ ɛr ʌp ɪn ˈbʌbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 對，噴孔把空氣往上推成泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the bubbles come out?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə ˈbʌbəlz kʌm aʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 泡泡是從哪裡冒出來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the bottom and from the side wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈbɑtəm ænd frʌm ðə saɪd wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 從池底，也從旁邊的池壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sit near the strongest jet?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ sɪt nɪr ðə ˈstrɔŋəst dʒɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以坐在最強的噴孔旁邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for long, it hurts the lower back.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fɔr lɔŋ ɪt hɜrts ðə ˈloʊər bæk./
dialogue.zh: 不要太久，那個會刺痛腰的下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is long here, ten seconds?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ɪz lɔŋ hɪr tɛn ˈsɛkəndz?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡算久是多久，十秒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One minute on the shoulders, then move away.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ɑn ðə ˈʃoʊldərz ðɛn muv əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 沖肩膀一分鐘，然後就要離開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the water level, it moves up.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə ˈwɔtər ˈlɛvəl ɪt muvz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 你看水位，它一直在上升。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fresh spring water runs in all day long.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ sprɪŋ ˈwɔtər rʌnz ɪn ɔl deɪ lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 新的溫泉水整天都在流進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All day, so the pool is never cold?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl deɪ soʊ ðə pul ɪz ˈnɛvɚ koʊld?/
dialogue.zh: 整天流，所以池子都不會變涼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, the pipe brings hot water from below.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ðə paɪp brɪŋz hɑt ˈwɔtər frʌm bɪˈloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 都不會，管子從下面把熱水送上來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How deep does the bubble pool go?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dip dʌz ðə ˈbʌbəl pul ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 氣泡池的水有多深？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chest deep for you, shoulder deep for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛst dip fɔr ju ˈʃoʊldər dip fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 到你胸口，我這裡到肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And this cold one, it says seventeen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðɪs koʊld wʌn ɪt sɛz ˌsɛvənˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 這個涼的，牌子上寫十七度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is for the arms and for the feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz fɔr ði ɑrmz ænd fɔr ðə fits./
dialogue.zh: 那個是給手臂和腳用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventeen degrees, do people really go in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɛvənˈtin dɪˈɡriz du ˈpipəl ˈrɪli ɡoʊ ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 十七度，真的有人整個下去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old man by the wall does it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊld mæn baɪ ðə wɔl dʌz ɪt twaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 牆邊那位阿公每天都下去兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we try it now, for a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi traɪ ɪt naʊ fɔr ə ˈmɪnɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在要不要試一下，一分鐘就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only ten seconds, cool your arms first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tɛn ˈsɛkəndz kul jɔr ɑrmz fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 十秒就好，先讓手臂涼一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, three, it is so cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri ɪt ɪz soʊ koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三，真的好冰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out with the air, do not hold it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt wɪð ði ɛr du nɑt hoʊld ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把氣吐出來，不要憋著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands feel like ice right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz fil laɪk aɪs raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我兩隻手現在像冰一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now go back to the warm water slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɡoʊ bæk tu ðə wɔrm ˈwɔtər ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 現在慢慢回到溫水那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Going back feels strange, it turns warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡoʊɪŋ bæk filz streɪndʒ ɪt tɜrnz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 回去的感覺很怪，水變得很暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what the cold pool is for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz wɑt ðə koʊld pul ɪz fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 這就是冷水池存在的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot and cold, then hot again, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑt ænd koʊld ðɛn hɑt əˈɡɛn raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 熱的、涼的，再回熱的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, but the three hot rounds stay three.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt bʌt ðə θri hɑt raʊndz steɪ θri./
dialogue.zh: 對，但是熱水三輪還是只能三輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cold pool does not count as one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə koʊld pul dʌz nɑt kaʊnt æz wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 冷水池不算其中一輪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one is only to wake you up.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈoʊnli tu weɪk ju ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 不算，那個只是把身體叫醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the sign by the door say?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə saɪn baɪ ðə dɔr seɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 門邊那個牌子寫什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists the temperature of all four pools.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lɪsts ðə ˈtɛmprətʃər əv ɔl fɔr pulz./
dialogue.zh: 上面列了四個池子的溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty two, forty, thirty eight, seventeen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ˈfɔrti ˈθɜrti eɪt ˌsɛvənˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 四十二、四十、三十八、十七。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the order from hottest to coolest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ði ˈɔrdər frʌm ˈhɑtəst tu kuˈlist./
dialogue.zh: 那是從最燙排到最涼的順序。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the big pool always the hottest?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə bɪɡ pul ˈɔlweɪz ðə ˈhɑtəst?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼大池永遠是最燙的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More water, so it holds the heat longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ˈwɔtər soʊ ɪt hoʊldz ðə hit ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 水比較多，熱度就能留得比較久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the temperature change during the day?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈtɛmprətʃər tʃeɪndʒ ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 溫度一整天都會變化嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, it climbs when the sun is high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ɪt klaɪmz wɛn ðə sʌn ɪz haɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一點點，太陽高的時候會再升。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the sun the outdoor water feels warmer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə sʌn ði ˈaʊtˌdɔr ˈwɔtər filz ˈwɔrmər./
dialogue.zh: 曬到太陽時，露天的水感覺更暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the number on the board stays thirty eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑn ðə bɔrd steɪz ˈθɜrti eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 可是牌子上的數字還是三十八度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone put a real thermometer in the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌwʌn pʊt ə ril ˈθɜrməˌmɛtər ɪn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 有人在牆上裝了一個真的溫度計。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The red line stands right at forty two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd laɪn stændz raɪt æt ˈfɔrti tu./
dialogue.zh: 紅線剛好停在四十二的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The red line and my skin both agree.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛd laɪn ænd maɪ skɪn boʊ əˈɡri./
dialogue.zh: 紅線和我皮膚的感覺一致。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more pools to test, we have time.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr pulz tu tɛst wi hæv taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 還有兩個池子要試，我們有時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water softer here than tap water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər ˈsɔfər hɪr ðæn tæp ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水比自來水更柔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it feels slippery, like a little soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt filz ˈslɪpəri laɪk ə ˈlɪtəl soʊp./
dialogue.zh: 對，摸起來滑滑的，像有一點肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not drink it, the sign says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt drɪŋk ɪt ðə saɪn sɛz soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這個不要喝，牌子上這樣寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I almost did, my mouth is open now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlˌmoʊst dɪd maɪ maʊθ ɪz ˈoʊpən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我差一點就喝了，嘴巴還張著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which pool is good for a bad knee?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ pul ɪz ɡʊd fɔr ə bæd ni?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一個池子對不好的膝蓋比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The warm one at forty two, my grandfather said.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔrm wʌn æt ˈfɔrti tu maɪ ˈɡrænˌfɑðər sɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我爺爺說過，是四十二度那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bubbles are better for my sore neck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌbəlz ɑr ˈbɛtɚ fɔr maɪ sɔr nɛk./
dialogue.zh: 氣泡池對我痠的脖子更有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten more minutes sitting, then round two starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɛn raʊnd tu stɑrts./
dialogue.zh: 再坐十分鐘，然後開始第二輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten fifteen on the clock, time for bubbles.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˌfɪfˈtin ɑn ðə klɑk taɪm fɔr ˈbʌbəlz./
dialogue.zh: 鐘上是十點十五，輪到氣泡池了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, twenty minutes have passed already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts hæv pæst ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，二十分鐘已經過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round two is the bubble pool, forty.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd tu ɪz ðə ˈbʌbəl pul ˈfɔrti./
dialogue.zh: 第二輪是氣泡池，四十度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And we leave at ten thirty, fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wi liv æt tɛn ˈθɜrti ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 我們十點半離開，泡十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not sit still, the bubbles push you.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt sɪt stɪl ðə ˈbʌbəlz pʊʃ ju./
dialogue.zh: 不要都不動，泡泡一直在推你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move your legs a little, keep the blood going.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv jɔr lɛɡz ə ˈlɪtəl kip ðə blʌd ˈɡoʊɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 腿動一下，讓血繼續跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sound of bubbles is so loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saʊnd əv ˈbʌbəlz ɪz soʊ laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 氣泡的聲音好大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hides talking, that is why it is quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt haɪdz ˈtɔkɪŋ ðæt ɪz waɪ ɪt ɪz ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 它蓋過了說話聲，所以看起來很安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders are under the moving water.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ɑr ˈʌndər ðə ˈmʊvɪŋ ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀都在流動的水下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let them sit there two minutes, then move.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ðɛm sɪt ðɛr tu ˈmɪnəts ðɛn muv./
dialogue.zh: 讓肩膀那裡泡兩分鐘，再換位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is forty too cool for a hot spring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈfɔrti tu kul fɔr ə hɑt sprɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 四十度對溫泉來說太涼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is hot enough, my fingers are red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz hɑt ɪˈnʌf maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑr rɛd./
dialogue.zh: 夠熱了，我的手指都紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the pool across the garden?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə pul əˈkrɔs ðə ˈɡɑrdən?/
dialogue.zh: 花園對面那個池子呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is the sign with all the numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ðə saɪn wɪð ɔl ðə ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 寫著數字的牌子就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point with your finger and read them to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt wɪð jɔr ˈfɪŋɡər ænd rid ðɛm tu mi./
dialogue.zh: 用手指著，唸給我聽一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty eight there, we go after this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti eɪt ðɛr wi ɡoʊ ˈæftər ðɪs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那邊是三十八度，這一輪結束後去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty two, the hot water in the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti tu ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər ɪn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 四十二度，就是牆壁出來的熱水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty here, I am sitting right in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti hɪr aɪ æm ˈsɪtɪŋ raɪt ɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這裡四十度，我正坐在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty eight waits outside by the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti eɪt weɪts ˌaʊtˈsaɪd baɪ ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 三十八度的在外面等我們，就在樹旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After this, with the mountain looking down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ðɪs wɪð ðə ˈmaʊntən ˈlʊkɪŋ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 這輪之後就能對著山往下看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seventeen is for a short cold dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɛvənˈtin ɪz fɔr ə ʃɔrt koʊld dɪp./
dialogue.zh: 十七度是讓人短時間冰一下的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We did it once, my hands are still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd ɪt wʌns maɪ hændz ɑr stɪl wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我們做過一次了，我的手現在還是熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to rinse before we leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu rɪns bɪˈfɔr wi liv?/
dialogue.zh: 離開之前需要再沖水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No rinse between pools, only after the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪns bɪˈtwin pulz ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə læst./
dialogue.zh: 池子之間不用沖，最後一輪才要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why no rinse between two pools?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ noʊ rɪns bɪˈtwin tu pulz?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼池子之間都不用沖水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The good stuff stays on your skin then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡʊd stʌf steɪz ɑn jɔr skɪn ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那樣好的東西才會留在皮膚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the spring stays on my arms all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə sprɪŋ steɪz ɑn maɪ ɑrmz ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 所以泉水會留在我手臂一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub one arm and smell it, still sulfur.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb wʌn ɑrm ænd smɛl ɪt stɪl ˈsʌlfər./
dialogue.zh: 搓一下手臂聞聞看，還是硫磺味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten twenty five now, five more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈtwɛnti faɪv naʊ faɪv mɔr ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 現在十點二十五，再五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then out, and I want that cold milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aʊt ænd aɪ wɑnt ðæt koʊld mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 然後上岸，我想喝那杯冰牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out at ten thirty, dry your feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt æt tɛn ˈθɜrti draɪ jɔr fits./
dialogue.zh: 十點半上岸，把腳擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No dripping in the hall, use this mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdrɪpɪŋ ɪn ðə hɔl juz ðɪs mæt./
dialogue.zh: 走廊裡不要一路滴水，踩這塊墊子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My wet skin gets cold so fast now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ wɛt skɪn ɡɛts koʊld soʊ fæst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 濕皮膚現在涼得特別快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap the big towel tight, then sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðə bɪɡ ˈtaʊəl taɪt ðɛn sɪt daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 大毛巾裹緊一點，然後坐下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us sit here, the light is nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs sɪt hɪr ðə laɪt ɪz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我們坐這裡吧，這個位置光線很柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, I will be right back, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt aɪ wɪl bi raɪt bæk oʊˈkeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 先坐下，我馬上回來，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are you going with wet hair?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɑr ju ˈɡoʊɪŋ wɪð wɛt hɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 你頭髮濕濕的要去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the cold milk, that is the rule here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə koʊld mɪlk ðæt ɪz ðə rul hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 去拿冰牛奶，這裡的規矩是這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk after soaking, I did not know.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ˈæftər ˈsoʊkɪŋ aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 泡完要喝牛奶，這件事我不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, everyone does it after the second round.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈɛvriˌwʌn dʌz ɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈsɛkənd raʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，每個人泡完第二輪都會來一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a shop inside this place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ʃɑp ɪnˈsaɪd ðɪs pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這棟建築裡面有小賣部嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small counter, by the rest room door.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl ˈkaʊntər baɪ ðə rɛst rum dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 一個小櫃檯，就在休息室的門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold milk in a little glass bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld mɪlk ɪn ə ˈlɪtəl ɡlæs ˈbɑtəl./
dialogue.zh: 冰牛奶裝在小玻璃瓶裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty for one, plain or banana.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti fɔr wʌn pleɪn ɔr bəˈnænə./
dialogue.zh: 一瓶六十元，原味或香蕉的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two bottles, that is one hundred twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈbɑtəlz ðæt ɪz wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 兩瓶就是一百二十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I take banana, you take the plain one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪk bəˈnænə ju teɪk ðə pleɪn wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我拿香蕉的，你拿原味那瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She knows you, that lady, she smiled.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi noʊz ju ðæt ˈleɪdi ʃi smaɪld./
dialogue.zh: 那位小姐認識你，她剛剛在笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My parents brought me here for years.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɛrənts brɔt mi hɪr fɔr jɪrz./
dialogue.zh: 我父母帶我來這裡好多年了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She gave me a straw without asking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɡeɪv mi ə strɔ ˈwɪðaʊt ˈæskɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她沒問就給我一根吸管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You look eight years old with that bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lʊk eɪt jɪrz oʊld wɪð ðæt ˈbɑtəl./
dialogue.zh: 你拿著那個瓶子看起來像八歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First sip, and my whole face is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst sɪp ænd maɪ hoʊl feɪs ɪz koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 第一口下去，我整張臉都涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink slow, your belly wants ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɪŋk sloʊ jɔr ˈbɛli wɑnts tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 喝慢一點，胃需要十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It goes down so far, I feel it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡoʊz daʊn soʊ fɑr aɪ fil ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那口涼的滑到好下面，我感覺得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now water too, you drank nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ ˈwɔtər tu ju dræŋk ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在也要喝水，你今天還沒喝東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free cups are on the other wall, see.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri kʌps ɑr ɑn ði ˈʌðər wɔl si./
dialogue.zh: 免費的杯子在另一面牆，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill two, we need them for round three.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪl tu wi nid ðɛm fɔr raʊnd θri./
dialogue.zh: 裝兩杯，第三輪我們會用到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No beer today, that was my plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ bɪr təˈdeɪ ðæt wəz maɪ plæn./
dialogue.zh: 今天不能喝啤酒，那是我原本的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, wine and hot water do not mix.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ waɪn ænd hɑt ˈwɔtər du nɑt mɪks./
dialogue.zh: 千萬不行，酒和熱水不能混在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are still warm from the pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr stɪl wɔrm frʌm ðə pul./
dialogue.zh: 我的手被池子暖到還是熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, and the bottle cools my skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ænd ðə ˈbɑtəl kulz maɪ skɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，瓶子貼著皮膚很涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a fan above the bench.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə fæn əˈbʌv ðə bɛntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 長椅上方有一颱風扇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not sit under it, you will freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt sɪt ˈʌndər ɪt ju wɪl friz./
dialogue.zh: 不要坐在它正下面，你會著涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, a sparrow on the stone lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ə ˈspæroʊ ɑn ðə stoʊn læmp./
dialogue.zh: 你看，石燈籠上面有一隻麻雀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes for the crumbs behind the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz fɔr ðə krʌmz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ʃɑp./
dialogue.zh: 牠來撿小賣部後面的碎屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That bamboo tap makes a sound every minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bæmˈbu tæp meɪks ə saʊnd ˈɛvri ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那個竹水龍頭每分鐘都會響一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I counted twelve knocks, it is steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd twɛlv nɑks ɪt ɪz ˈstɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我數了十二下，聲音很固定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sound puts me to sleep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊnd pʊts mi tu ˈslip ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 那個聲音已經快把我哄睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it for tonight, we sleep at ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt fɔr təˈnaɪt wi slip æt tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 留到今晚吧，我們十點才睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An old man is snoring on that mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈoʊld mæn ɪz ˈsnɔrɪŋ ɑn ðæt mæt./
dialogue.zh: 那條墊子上有位老先生在打呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Towel on his face, blanket on his legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaʊəl ɑn hɪz feɪs ˈblæŋkɪt ɑn hɪz lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 臉上蓋毛巾，腿上蓋毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we laugh a little at him?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi læf ə ˈlɪtəl æt hɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以小聲笑他一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, everyone sleeps here, it is normal.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛvriˌwʌn slips hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈnɔrməl./
dialogue.zh: 不行，在這裡睡覺很平常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cat walked under the bench now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kæt wɔkt ˈʌndər ðə bɛntʃ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 剛剛有一隻貓走到椅子下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop cat, she waits for milk caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp kæt ʃi weɪts fɔr mɪlk kæps./
dialogue.zh: 那是店裡的貓，她在等瓶蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have no cap to give her.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv noʊ kæp tu ɡɪv hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 我沒有瓶蓋可以給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give her nothing, she only wants a place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɜr ˈnʌθɪŋ ʃi ˈoʊnli wɑnts ə pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 什麼都別給，她只想佔個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is half dry, look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr ɪz hæf draɪ lʊk æt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮已經半乾了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the fan in the drying room later.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə fæn ɪn ðə ˈdraɪɪŋ rum ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 等一下去烘髮室用吹風機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the drying room, by the mirrors?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈdraɪɪŋ rum baɪ ðə ˈmɪrərz?/
dialogue.zh: 烘髮室在哪裡，在鏡子那邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two dryers, take a coin from me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ˈdraiərz teɪk ə kɔɪn frʌm mi./
dialogue.zh: 對，兩臺吹風機，拿我一枚硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A coin for ten minutes of warm air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə kɔɪn fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnəts əv wɔrm ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 一枚硬幣可以吹十分鐘的暖風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes is plenty for my short hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɪz ˈplɛnti fɔr maɪ ʃɔrt hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我頭髮短，十分鐘綽綽有餘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My milk bottle is empty already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ mɪlk ˈbɑtəl ɪz ˈɛmpli ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 我的牛奶瓶已經空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy another? Sixty, I will have one too.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ əˈnʌðər ˈsɪksti aɪ wɪl hæv wʌn tu./
dialogue.zh: 再買一瓶？六十元，我也要一瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more bottles, then we stop, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ˈbɑtəlz ðɛn wi stɑp raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 再兩瓶，然後就不喝了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the fridge has only three left.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə frɪdʒ hæz ˈoʊnli θri lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 對，冰箱裡只剩三瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much did we spend on milk now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dɪd wi spɛnd ɑn mɪlk naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在花多少錢在牛奶上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four bottles, two hundred forty in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈbɑtəlz tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈfɔrti ɪn ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 四瓶，一共兩百四十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our tickets were nine hundred this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈtɪkəts wɜr naɪn ˈhʌndrəd ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 早上的門票是九百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the bottles in the box, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈbɑtəlz ɪn ðə bɑks pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 請把空瓶放回那個箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do they take the bottles back?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ du ðeɪ teɪk ðə ˈbɑtəlz bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼他們要把瓶子收回去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Glass goes home, gets washed, comes back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡlæs ɡoʊz hoʊm ɡɛts wɑʃt kʌmz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 玻璃拿回去洗，然後再裝滿送回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like sitting here with nothing to do.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ laɪk ˈsɪtɪŋ hɪr wɪθ ˈnʌθɪŋ tu du./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡坐在這裡什麼都不做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole point of a hot spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl pɔɪnt əv ə hɑt sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那就是泡溫泉全部的重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes close by themselves, so warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ aɪz kloʊz baɪ ðɛmˈsɛlvz soʊ wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我的眼睛自己閉上了，好暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest ten minutes, then the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst tɛn ˈmɪnəts ðɛn ði ˈʌðər saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 休息十分鐘，然後去另一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That far side is the one outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɑr saɪd ɪz ðə wʌn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 另一邊就是外面那個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the stone pool under the trees.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə stoʊn pul ˈʌndər ðə triz./
dialogue.zh: 對，樹下面的那個石頭池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is thirty eight there, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈθɜrti eɪt ðɛr rɪˈmɛmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 那裡是三十八度，還記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remember, and only fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər ænd ˈoʊnli ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 記得，而且只能泡十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up slow this time, promise me.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ʌp sloʊ ðɪs taɪm ˈprɑmɪs mi./
dialogue.zh: 這一次站起來要慢，答應我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold your arm and count to five.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld jɔr ɑrm ænd kaʊnt tu faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 我會扶著你的手臂，數到五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That clock says ten fifty, rest more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt klɑk sɛz tɛn ˈfɪfti rɛst mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 鐘上寫十點五十，再多休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round three starts at eleven twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd θri stɑrts æt əˈlɛvən ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 第三輪十一點二十開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That gives us thirty minutes of rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡɪvz ʌs ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnəts əv rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 那樣我們能休息三十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: More than twenty, the sign says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ðæn ˈtwɛnti ðə saɪn sɛz soʊ./
dialogue.zh: 比規定的二十分鐘還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to sit in the sun a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu sɪt ɪn ðə sʌn ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 我想在太陽下坐一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes only, then you will sweat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnəts ˈoʊnli ðɛn ju wɪl swɛt./
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘就好，之後你就會流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweat now means dizzy later, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /swɛt naʊ minz ˈdɪzi ˈleɪtər raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 現在流汗，等一下就會頭暈，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, so drink water, not just milk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ drɪŋk ˈwɔtər nɑt dʒʌst mɪlk./
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，所以要喝水，不能只喝牛奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head feels fine, the air helps here.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd filz faɪn ði ɛr hɛlps hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我腦袋覺得沒事，這裡的空氣很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, because round three is outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd bɪˈkɔz raʊnd θri ɪz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 很好，因為第三輪在戶外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we carry our towels outside there?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈkæri ˈaʊər ˈtaʊəlz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要把毛巾帶到外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both, and your slippers too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs boʊθ ænd jɔr ˈslɪpərz tu./
dialogue.zh: 要，兩條都要，拖鞋也帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the floor is stone, not tile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə flɔr ɪz stoʊn nɑt taɪl./
dialogue.zh: 外面地面是石頭，不是磁磚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Still wet, so the same slow walking.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl wɛt soʊ ðə seɪm sloʊ ˈwɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 還是濕的，所以要一樣慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the clouds behind the mountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə klaʊdz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈmaʊntən./
dialogue.zh: 看看山後面的那些雲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come down around four in the afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ kʌm daʊn əˈraʊnd fɔr ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn./
dialogue.zh: 大約下午四點雲就會壓下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can sit here all day, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn sɪt hɪr ɔl deɪ aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我想我們可以在這裡坐一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not all day, we have lunch at twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɔl deɪ wi hæv lʌntʃ æt twɛlv./
dialogue.zh: 不能整天，我們十二點要吃午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lunch first or one more milk first?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌntʃ fɜrst ɔr wʌn mɔr mɪlk fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 先吃午餐，還是先再一瓶牛奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Milk later, now only water with lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ˈleɪtər naʊ ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər wɪð lʌntʃ./
dialogue.zh: 牛奶等一下，午餐配水就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the lady say the eggs are today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈleɪdi seɪ ði ɛɡz ɑr təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那位小姐有說今天有溫泉蛋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, three boiled in the spring water.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs θri bɔld ɪn ðə sprɪŋ ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 有，三顆是用泉水煮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty for three, we saw it on the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti fɔr θri wi sɔ ɪt ɑn ðə bɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 三顆六十元，我們在牌子上看過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eggs in the rest room, after round three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡz ɪn ðə rɛst rum ˈæftər raʊnd θri./
dialogue.zh: 蛋放在休息室，第三輪之後吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is eleven five, I want to rinse again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz əˈlɛvən faɪv aɪ wɑnt tu rɪns əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 已經十一點五分，我想再去沖一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit, we still have fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt wi stɪl hæv ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 坐著，我們還有十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen, then the stone pool at thirty eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ðɛn ðə stoʊn pul æt ˈθɜrti eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘後，就去三十八度的石頭池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I count your fifteen this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd aɪ kaʊnt jɔr ˌfɪfˈtin ðɪs taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 好，這一次換我幫你數十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step on the stones, not the grass.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ɑn ðə stoʊnz nɑt ðə ɡræs./
dialogue.zh: 踩石頭，不要踩草。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My slippers flap on every stone.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈslɪpərz flæp ɑn ˈɛvri stoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我的拖鞋每踩一顆石頭就啪一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This stone path is warm from the sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs stoʊn pæθ ɪz wɔrm frʌm ðə sʌn./
dialogue.zh: 石板路被太陽曬得暖暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, one stone has a loose place.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɛrfəl wʌn stoʊn hæz ə lus pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 小心，有一顆石頭是鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, smaller than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ˈsmɔlər ðæn aɪ θɔt./
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，比我以為的小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaves on the water, nobody swims here.
dialogue.phonetic: /livz ɑn ðə ˈwɔtər ˈnoʊˌbɑdi swɪmz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 水面上有樹葉，沒有人在這裡游泳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The stone edge is smooth from hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊn ɛdʒ ɪz smuð frʌm hændz./
dialogue.zh: 池邊被摸得很平滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old hands, many years of holding it.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld hændz ˈmɛni jɪrz əv ˈhoʊldɪŋ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那是很多年的手抓出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steam is thinner out in the air.
dialogue.phonetic: /stim ɪz ˈθɪnər aʊt ɪn ði ɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在戶外蒸氣比較淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But thirty eight is still hot enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ˈθɜrti eɪt ɪz stɪl hɑt ɪˈnʌf./
dialogue.zh: 但三十八度還是夠熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit on the edge, put feet in.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ði ɛdʒ pʊt fits ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 先坐池邊，把腳放進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, four, five, it feels good.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri fɔr faɪv ɪt filz ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三、四、五，感覺很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs disappear under the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz ˌdɪsəˈpɪr ˈʌndər ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 我的腿在水下面看不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, the stones make a green shadow.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu ðə stoʊnz meɪk ə ɡrin ˈʃæˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，石頭讓水變成綠影。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In we go, both of us slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn wi ɡoʊ boʊθ əv ʌs sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們下去，兩個人都慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoulders under, and no talking for a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz ˈʌndər ænd noʊ ˈtɔkɪŋ fɔr ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 肩膀淹過去，一會兒都不要說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven twenty two, I start the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛvən ˈtwɛnti tu aɪ stɑrt ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 十一點二十二，我開始計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen minutes, so eleven thirty five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts soʊ əˈlɛvən ˈθɜrti faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 十五分鐘，那就是十一點三十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This water holds me, I can let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwɔtər hoʊldz mi aɪ kæn lɛt ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 水托著我，我可以放手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not let go of the wall, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lɛt ɡoʊ əv ðə wɔl ðoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 不過先別放開池壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A leaf floats past my knee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lif flots pæst maɪ ni./
dialogue.zh: 一片葉子飄過我的膝蓋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it go, the drain takes it away.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ɡoʊ ðə dreɪn teɪks ɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 讓它走，洞口會把它帶走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mountain sits right above this pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmaʊntən sɪts raɪt əˈbʌv ðɪs pul./
dialogue.zh: 山就在這個池子的上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the trees move, but nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə triz muv bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 只有樹在動，別的都不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten minutes gone, I want ten more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɡɑn aɪ wɑnt tɛn mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 過了十分鐘，我還想再十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No more, fifteen is the line today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr ˌfɪfˈtin ɪz ðə laɪn təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不能更多，今天十五分鐘就是界線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a little more, it feels so good.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr ɪt filz soʊ ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 再多一點點，太舒服了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said that at the big pool too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd ðæt æt ðə bɪɡ pul tu./
dialogue.zh: 你在大池的時候也這樣說過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven thirty five, or is it later?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛvən ˈθɜrti faɪv ɔr ɪz ɪt ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 十一點三十五了嗎，還是更晚了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eleven forty two, that is over the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛvən ˈfɔrti tu ðæt ɪz ˈoʊvɚ ðə laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 十一點四十二，已經超過時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes, that is five too many.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts ðæt ɪz faɪv tu ˈmɛni./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘，多了五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out now, and stand up very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt naʊ ænd stænd ʌp ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 現在上岸，站起來要非常慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I stand, and the trees all move.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stænd ænd ðə triz ɔl muv./
dialogue.zh: 我一站起來，樹全部都在移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down again, hold this rail for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn əˈɡɛn hoʊld ðɪs reɪl fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 再坐下去，幫我抓這根欄杆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything here turns around once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ hɪr tɜrnz əˈraʊnd wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 整個花園轉了一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean on the wall, put your head down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lin ɑn ðə wɔl pʊt jɔr hɛd daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 靠在池壁上，頭低下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head is light, my hands are not.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd ɪz laɪt maɪ hændz ɑr nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我頭輕輕的，手卻沒有力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe with me, in for four, out for six.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið wɪð mi ɪn fɔr fɔr aʊt fɔr sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 跟著我呼吸，吸四拍、吐六拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more round of that, then better.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr raʊnd əv ðæt ðɛn ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 再呼吸一次，就會好一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay sitting, I will get the cool towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /steɪ ˈsɪtɪŋ aɪ wɪl ɡɛt ðə kul ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 坐著別動，我去拿涼的毛巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold tap water is what helps right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld tæp ˈwɔtər ɪz wɑt hɛls raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 涼的自來水才有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neck and wrists, the two fastest places.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛk ænd rɪsts ðə tu ˈfæstəst ˈpleɪsɪz./
dialogue.zh: 脖子和手腕，這兩個地方最快生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who put this cold thing here?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu pʊt ðɪs koʊld θɪŋ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 誰把這個涼涼的東西放這裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me, keep it there, and say nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi kip ɪt ðɛr ænd seɪ ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我放的，就那樣別動，閉嘴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back against stone, this wall is hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk əˈɡɛnst stoʊn ðɪs wɔl ɪz hɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 我背後的石壁好硬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, it holds you while the world stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ɪt hoʊldz ju waɪl ðə wɜrld stɑps./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，它撐住你直到世界停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lady from the counter came out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪdi frʌm ðə ˈkaʊntər keɪm aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯那位小姐走出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She asks how long you sat in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æsks haʊ lɔŋ ju sæt ɪn ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 她問你剛剛在水裡泡了多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I said twenty, and she did not smile.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛd ˈtwɛnti ænd ʃi dɪd nɑt smaɪl./
dialogue.zh: 我說二十分鐘，她沒有笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says fifteen, never twenty, for anyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ˌfɪfˈtin ˈnɛvɚ ˈtwɛnti fɔr ˈɛnɪˌwʌn./
dialogue.zh: 她說不管誰，都只有十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She brings a chair and one more cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi brɪŋz ə tʃɛr ænd wʌn mɔr kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 她拿來一張椅子和一個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit an hour if you need, she says.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ən aʊr ɪf ju nid ʃi sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 她說需要的話坐一個小時也沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She is right, my feet are cold now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz raɪt maɪ fits ɑr koʊld naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她說得對，我現在腳是冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blood goes to the hot water, not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /blʌd ɡoʊz tu ðə hɑt ˈwɔtər nɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 血都跑到熱水那邊，不在腦袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that why my head felt empty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt waɪ maɪ hɛd fɛlt ˈɛmpti?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我頭才會覺得空空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and you stood up way too fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ju stʊd ʌp weɪ tu fæst./
dialogue.zh: 對，而且你站得太快了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I eat enough? Only tea at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd aɪ it ɪˈnʌf ˈoʊnli ti æt eɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我吃得夠嗎？八點只喝了茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the second reason, now drink this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈrizən naʊ drɪŋk ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 那是第二個原因，現在喝這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water, not milk, fine, I drink it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər nɑt mɪlk faɪn aɪ drɪŋk ɪt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 是水不是牛奶，好吧，我全部喝光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow sips, your belly is empty too.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ sɪps jɔr ˈbɛli ɪz ˈɛmpti tu./
dialogue.zh: 一小口一小口喝，你胃也是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven fifty, the garden is not turning.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛvən ˈfɪfti ðə ˈɡɑrdən ɪz nɑt ˈtɜrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 十一點五十，花園沒有在轉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sign, stay ten more minutes, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd saɪn steɪ tɛn mɔr ˈmɪnəts pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 好現象，再坐十分鐘好嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No more pools today, that is the deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɔr pulz təˈdeɪ ðæt ɪz ðə dil./
dialogue.zh: 今天不能再泡了，這是條件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, three rounds, forty five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil θri raʊndz ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 成交，三輪、四十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a bell here, what is it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɛl hɪr wʌt ɪz ɪt fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一個鈴，那是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ring it if you cannot stand up.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪŋ ɪt ɪf ju ˈkænɑt stænd ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 站不起來的時候就按它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope we never need that bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp wi ˈnɛvɚ nid ðæt bɛl./
dialogue.zh: 我希望我們永遠用不到那個鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, but hot water is not a joke.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu bʌt hɑt ˈwɔtər ɪz nɑt ə dʒok./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，但熱水開不起玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, I soak, you watch the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ soʊk ju wɑtʃ ðə klɑk./
dialogue.zh: 下次我泡著，你幫我盯鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and we both stand up at fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd wi boθ stænd ʌp æt ˌfɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 好，十五分鐘一到我們兩個一起站。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head is back, I promise you.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛd ɪz bæk aɪ ˈprɑmɪs ju./
dialogue.zh: 我腦袋回來了，我跟你保證。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say it twice, then we walk inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɪt twaɪs ðɛn wi wɔk ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 說兩次，然後我們走回室內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up first, then hold my arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ʌp fɜrst ðɛn hoʊld maɪ ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 你先站起來，再抓我的手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, count to ten, then take one step.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt kaʊnt tu tɛn ðɛn teɪk wʌn stɛp./
dialogue.zh: 等一下，數到十再踏出一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking is strange, my legs feel far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔkɪŋ ɪz streɪndʒ maɪ lɛɡz fil fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 走路怪怪的，我的腿像很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow steps on the stones, hold the rope.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ stɛps ɑn ðə stoʊnz hoʊld ðə roʊp./
dialogue.zh: 在石板上慢慢走，抓繩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, the warm air hits my face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə wɔrm ɛr hɪts maɪ feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 一進室內，暖氣就打在我臉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the change, sit by the taps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə tʃeɪndʒ sɪt baɪ ðə tæps./
dialogue.zh: 那就是溫差，坐在水龍頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we rinse for real, after the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi rɪns fɔr ril ˈæftər ðə læst./
dialogue.zh: 現在真的要沖洗了，因為是最後一輪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soap this time, hair and everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊp ðɪs taɪm hɛr ænd ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 對，這次要用肥皂，頭髮全部洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The foam feels good after three pools.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə foʊm filz ɡʊd ˈæftər θri pulz./
dialogue.zh: 泡了三個池子之後泡沫很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash the sulfur off, you smell strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ðə ˈsʌlfər ɑf ju smɛl stɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 把硫磺洗掉，你味道很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair still holds the towel band.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr stɪl hoʊldz ðə ˈtaʊəl bænd./
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮還用毛巾綁著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it off, I will wash your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt ɑf aɪ wɪl wɑʃ jɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 拿下來，我幫你洗背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eleven fifty five, we rinse too long.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɛvən ˈfɪfti faɪv wi rɪns tu lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 十一點五十五，我們沖太久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lunch waits, but the room closes at two.
