dialogue.phonetic: /lʌntʃ weɪts bʌt ðə rum ˈkloʊsɪz æt tu./
dialogue.zh: 午餐會等，但用餐區兩點就關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry feet, dry hair, no wet clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ fits draɪ hɛr noʊ wɛt kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 擦乾腳、擦乾頭髮，別穿濕衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The dryer gets one coin for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraiər ɡɛts wʌn kɔɪn fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 吹風機我投一枚硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dressed at last, my back is happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɛst æt læst maɪ bæk ɪz ˈhæpi./
dialogue.zh: 總算穿好衣服，我的背很高興。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine ached the whole time, I know now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ekt ðə hoʊl taɪm aɪ noʊ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我整個早上都在痠，現在才知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock says twelve, right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə klɑk sɛz twɛlv raɪt ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 鐘上十二點，我們剛好準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slow, do not carry the bags today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔk sloʊ du nɑt ˈkæri ðə bæɡz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今天走慢一點，袋子別讓我們拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My bag is light, my body is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæɡ ɪz laɪt maɪ ˈbɑdi ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我的包很輕，身體卻不輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Robe next, then tea, then all the food.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊb nɛkst ðɛn ti ðɛn ɔl ðə fud./
dialogue.zh: 再來是浴衣，然後茶，然後全部吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve ten, the lunch room is still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv tɛn ðə lʌntʃ rum ɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 十二點十分，用餐區還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the robe desk is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə roʊb dɛsk ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對，借浴衣的櫃子就在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One hundred for the robe, you keep it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈhʌndrəd fɔr ðə roʊb ju kip ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 浴衣一百元，是送我們嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you return it, one hundred is the fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ju rɪˈtɜrn ɪt wʌn ˈhʌndrəd ɪz ðə fi./
dialogue.zh: 不是，要還的，一百元是借用費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are both alive, a little dizzy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr boʊθ əˈlaɪv ə ˈlɪtəl ˈdɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個都還活著，有點暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Alive and hungry, that is enough for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaɪv ænd ˈhʌŋɡri ðæt ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr mi./
dialogue.zh: 活著又很餓，這樣就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us walk to the other hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs wɔk tu ði ˈʌðər hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 我們走到另一邊的廳看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The covered way by the parking lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌvərd weɪ baɪ ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ lɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 走那條有屋頂的路，停車場那邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, ten steps past the vending machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɛn stɛps pæst ðə ˈvɛndɪŋ məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 對，自動販賣機再過去十步。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one, the hall with the wooden roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ðə hɔl wɪð ðə ˈwʊdən ruf./
dialogue.zh: 就是那個，屋頂全木頭的大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that hall for men in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt hɔl fɔr mɛn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個廳早上是給男生的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They clean it at ten, so it opens late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ klin ɪt æt tɛn soʊ ɪt ˈoʊpənz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 他們十點打掃，所以開得比較晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thirty now, we have time for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈθɜrti naʊ wi hæv taɪm fɔr ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 現在一點半，我們有時間去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty is the limit for that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz ðə ˈlɪmɪt fɔr ðæt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 那個池子的上限是二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sign there says thirty six degrees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saɪn ðɛr sɛz ˈθɜrti sɪks dɪˈɡriz./
dialogue.zh: 那邊那塊牌寫三十六度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty six is a warm pool, not hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti sɪks ɪz ə wɔrm pul nɑt hɑt./
dialogue.zh: 三十六度是溫水池，不是熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it does not count as a round?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɪt dʌz nɑt kaʊnt æz ə raʊnd?/
dialogue.zh: 那它不算其中一輪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, this one is a slow, easy soak.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðɪs wʌn ɪz ə sloʊ ˈizi soʊk./
dialogue.zh: 對，這一邊是慢慢泡的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy how long, can I say thirty?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi haʊ lɔŋ kæn aɪ seɪ ˈθɜrti?/
dialogue.zh: 慢泡可以多久，三十分鐘可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty is plenty here, the water moves you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ɪz ˈplɛnti hɪr ðə ˈwɔtər muvz ju./
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘就夠了，水會一直推你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our three rounds are done for today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər θri raʊndz ɑr dʌn fɔr təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們今天的三輪已經用完了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, unless we stay and get a new day.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌnˈlɛs wi steɪ ænd ɡɛt ə nu deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 用完了，除非我們住下來過隔天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy door, push it with your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvɪ dɔr pʊʃ ɪt wɪð jɔr bæk./
dialogue.zh: 門很重，用背推。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open, and look, the whole room is wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ænd lʊk ðə hoʊl rum ɪz wʊd./
dialogue.zh: 開了，你看，整個房間都是木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wood on the walls and on the roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɑn ðə wɔlz ænd ɑn ðə ruf./
dialogue.zh: 牆壁是木頭，屋頂也是木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like a forest in the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz laɪk ə ˈfɔrəst ɪn ðə ren./
dialogue.zh: 聞起來像雨裡的森林。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small pool, that is all we get?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl pul ðæt ɪz ɔl wi ɡɛt?/
dialogue.zh: 只有一個小池，我們就只有這個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pool, one cold tap, and two chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pul wʌn koʊld tæp ænd tu tʃɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 一個池子、一個冷水龍頭、兩張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That window looks back at our stone pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈwɪnˌdoʊ lʊks bæk æt ˈaʊər stoʊn pul./
dialogue.zh: 窗戶剛好看得到我們的岩石池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We were sitting there two hours ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɜr ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɛr tu aʊrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 兩小時前我們還坐在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we see it from the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi si ɪt frʌm ði ˈʌðər saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 現在我們從另一邊看它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the mountain looks smaller from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈmaʊntən lʊks ˈsmɔlər frʌm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 山從這看起來比較小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who is this man with the big tattoo?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ɪz ðɪs mæn wɪð ðə bɪɡ tæˈtu?/
dialogue.zh: 那個有大片刺青的人是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He covers his back with a small towel.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈkʌvərz hɪz bæk wɪð ə smɔl ˈtaʊəl./
dialogue.zh: 他用小毛巾蓋住他的背。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does he mind that we are looking?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hi maɪnd ðæt wi ɑr ˈlʊkɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 他在意我們一直在看嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He saw us first and laughed a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɔ ʌs fɜrst ænd læft ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 他先看到我們，自己笑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mother is washing a baby's arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmʌðər ɪz ˈwɑʃɪŋ ə ˈbeɪbiz ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 有一位媽媽在幫嬰兒洗手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She uses only water, no soap for babies.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈjuzɪz ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər noʊ soʊp fɔr ˈbeɪbiz./
dialogue.zh: 她只用清水，嬰兒不用肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Babies can come in at what age?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbeɪbiz kæn kʌm ɪn æt wʌt eɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 嬰兒幾個月大可以下水？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk says three months or older.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk sɛz θri mʌnθs ɔr ˈoldər./
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯寫三個月以上才可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this side quieter than our first one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs saɪd ˈkwaɪətər ðæn ˈaʊər fɜrst wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 這邊比我們早上那個安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much quieter, only four people and no talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈkwaɪətər ˈoʊnli fɔr ˈpipəl ænd noʊ ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 安靜多了，只有四個人，也沒人說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take off your slippers at the step here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɑf jɔr ˈslɪpərz æt ðə stɛp hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 就在這個階梯前脫拖鞋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in a row, like the others.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm ɪn ə roʊ laɪk ði ˈʌðərz./
dialogue.zh: 排成一列，像別人的那樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse first, even in a warm pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns fɜrst ˈivən ɪn ə wɔrm pul./
dialogue.zh: 就算是溫水池也要先沖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, same stool, same two buckets there.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs seɪm stul seɪm tu ˈbʌkətz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 對，一樣的板凳，一樣兩個桶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sit, I pour, I am ready now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɪt aɪ pɔr aɪ æm ˈrɛdi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我坐好、潑水，我準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, and this water feels cool first.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu ænd ðɪs ˈwɔtər filz kul fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不過這水一開始覺得涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool? The big pool was forty two.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ðə bɪɡ pul wəz ˈfɔrti tu./
dialogue.zh: 涼？大池本來可是四十二度耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it one minute, then it turns warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt wʌn ˈmɪnɪt ðɛn ɪt tɜrnz wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 給它一分鐘，之後就變暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You were right, my shoulders are soft now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɜr raɪt maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ɑr sɔft naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你說對了，我肩膀現在變軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty six stays on the skin longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti sɪks steɪz ɑn ðə skɪn ˈlɔŋɡər./
dialogue.zh: 三十六度的暖會留在皮膚比較久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we just stay here a little more?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi dʒʌst steɪ hɪr ə ˈlɪtəl mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能不能在這裡再多待一下？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can, but twenty is our own rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn bʌt ˈtwɛnti ɪz ˈaʊər oʊn rul./
dialogue.zh: 可以，但我們自己的規矩是二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, the water moves my whole chest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðə ˈwɔtər muvz maɪ hoʊl tʃɛst./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水一直在推我整個胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe easy, do not push against it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ˈizi du nɑt pʊʃ əˈɡɛnst ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆呼吸，不要對抗那個力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A drip falls every three seconds here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə drɪp fɔlz ˈɛvri θri ˈsɛkəndz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡每三秒就有一滴水落下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That tap fills the pool, it never stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tæp fɪlz ðə pul ɪt ˈnɛvər stɑps./
dialogue.zh: 那個水龍頭在幫池子加水，從不暫停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hear my own heart now, so quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr maɪ oʊn hɑrt naʊ soʊ ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 我現在聽得到自己的心跳，好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quiet is what you pay for here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət ɪz wɑt ju peɪ fɔr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，安靜才是你花錢買的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two o'clock, we have been in a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu əˈklɑk wi hæv bɪn ɪn ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 兩點整了，我們已經泡了一陣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out we go, then dry off very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt wi ɡoʊ ðɛn draɪ ɑf ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 上岸吧，然後再慢慢地擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing up is easy this time, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ ʌp ɪz ˈizi ðɪs taɪm si?/
dialogue.zh: 這一次站起來很容易，看到了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, no garden turning round today.
dialogue.phonetic: /si noʊ ˈɡɑrdən ˈtɜrnɪŋ raʊnd təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 看到了，今天花園沒有在轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold tap on my wrists, once again.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld tæp ɑn maɪ rɪsts wʌns əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 再一次把涼水沖在手腕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good habit, now go and dress warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈhæbɪt naʊ ɡoʊ ænd drɛs wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 好習慣，現在去把衣服穿暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shirt is still damp from the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrt ɪz stɪl dæmp frʌm ðə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 我的襯衫從袋子拿出來還是潮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fan in the hall fixes that fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn ɪn ðə hɔl ˈfɪksɪz ðæt fæst./
dialogue.zh: 廳裡的風扇很快就能解決。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fifteen, the desk opens for check in.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪftɛn ðə dɛsk ˈoʊpənz fɔr tʃɛk ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 兩點十五，櫃檯開始辦入住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only stairs, so we carry small bags up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli stɛrz soʊ wi ˈkæri smɔl bæɡz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 這裡只有樓梯，所以我們拿小包上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much for one night in this place?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ fɔr wʌn naɪt ɪn ðɪs pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡住一晚多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two thousand six hundred, two meals inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈθaʊzənd sɪks ˈhʌndrəd tu milz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 兩千六百，包含兩餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two meals? Dinner and breakfast in the hall?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu milz ˈdɪnər ænd ˈbrɛkfəst ɪn ðə hɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 兩餐？晚餐和早餐都在大廳吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, six for dinner, seven for breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs sɪks fɔr ˈdɪnər ˈsɛvən fɔr ˈbrɛkfəst./
dialogue.zh: 對，晚餐六點，早餐七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That covers all the baths in the day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʌvərz ɔl ðə bæθz ɪn ðə deɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 那個價錢包含整天所有泡湯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every bath, hot or warm, no more tickets.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri bæθ hɑt ɔr wɔrm noʊ mɔr ˈtɪkəts./
dialogue.zh: 每一個池都算，熱的溫的，不用再買票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And our morning tickets, do they count?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈaʊər ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈtɪkəts du ðeɪ kaʊnt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們早上買的票可以折抵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine hundred goes inside the room price.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈhʌndrəd ɡoʊz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə rum praɪs./
dialogue.zh: 九百元直接算進房價裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So five thousand two hundred, minus nine?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ faɪv ˈθaʊzənd tu ˈhʌndrəd ˈmɪnəs naɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 所以五千二百減掉九百？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four thousand three hundred on the card now.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈθaʊzənd θri ˈhʌndrəd ɑn ðə kɑrd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在刷卡四千三百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room two oh five, the second floor here.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum tu oʊ faɪv ðə ˈsɛkənd flɔr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 二○五號房，就在二樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No elevator, only steps, so take it slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɛləˌveɪtər ˈoʊnli stɛps soʊ teɪk ɪt sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒有電梯，只有階梯，慢慢走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two single rooms or one big room?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsɪŋɡəl rʊmz ɔr wʌn bɪɡ rum?/
dialogue.zh: 兩間單人房，還是一間大房？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One big room, two beds, and one low window.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɪɡ rum tu bɛdz ænd wʌn loʊ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 一間大房，兩張床，一個低低的窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We pay with the card, the same one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi peɪ wɪð ðə kɑrd ðə seɪm wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們還是用那張卡付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and keep that paper, we need it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd kip ðæt ˈpeɪpər wi nid ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，那張單子留著，我們會用到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three o'clock, our room is ready now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri əˈklɑk ˈaʊər rum ɪz ˈrɛdi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 三點整，我們的房間準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keys, two tags on one small ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiz tu tæɡz ɑn wʌn smɔl rɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙是兩個木牌，穿在同一個小圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do our two towels go now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ˈaʊər tu ˈtaʊəlz ɡoʊ naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們那兩條毛巾現在要放回哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back in the basket, the room has four.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn ðə ˈbæskət ðə rum hæz fɔr./
dialogue.zh: 放回門邊的籃子就好，房間裡有四條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bath mats are warm, look at them.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæθ mæts ɑr wɔrm lʊk æt ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 浴室的墊子是暖的，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The floor is warm on purpose, she says.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr ɪz wɔrm ɑn ˈpɜrpəs ʃi sɛz./
dialogue.zh: 她說是刻意把地板做熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The windows face the garden, our stone pool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊz feɪs ðə ˈɡɑrdən ˈaʊər stoʊn pul./
dialogue.zh: 窗子面對花園，面對那個岩石池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can see the steam from our bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn si ðə stim frʌm ˈaʊər bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我們從床上就可以看到蒸氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner is at six, what do we wear?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪnər ɪz æt sɪks wʌt du wi wɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 晚餐六點，我們穿什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The robe, of course, and clean paper socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊb əv kɔrs ænd klin ˈpeɪpər sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 當然是浴衣，再加乾淨的紙襪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We give back the robe from noon, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɪv bæk ðə roʊb frʌm nun raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 中午那件浴衣要還，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, guests keep the room robe all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɡɛsts kip ðə rum roʊb ɔl naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 對，房客那件可以穿整個晚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will give it back before the food.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡɪv ɪt bæk bɪˈfɔr ðə fud./
dialogue.zh: 我會在吃飯之前先還回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The desk is open, the box is right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɛsk ɪz ˈoʊpən ðə bɑks ɪz raɪt ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 櫃檯開著，回收箱就在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three forty now, we have time for tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈfɔrti naʊ wi hæv taɪm fɔr ti./
dialogue.zh: 現在三點四十，我們還有時間去喝茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tea place is in the second hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti pleɪs ɪz ɪn ðə ˈsɛkənd hɔl./
dialogue.zh: 喝茶的地方在第二個廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can sit on the floor there, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn sɪt ɑn ðə flɔr ðɛr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 在那裡我們可以坐在地上，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cushions and mats, shoes stay at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊʃənz ænd mæts ʃuz steɪ æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 有坐墊和榻榻米，鞋子留在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the robe, then tea, then the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə roʊb ðɛn ti ðɛn ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 然後穿浴衣、喝茶，再休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And tonight we try the warm pool, five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd təˈnaɪt wi traɪ ðə wɔrm pul faɪv./
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們試那個溫水池，五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The robe desk has two colors today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊb dɛsk hæz tu ˈkʌlərz təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 借浴衣的櫃檯今天有兩種顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue or gray, and both are free for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɔr ɡre ænd boʊθ ɑr fri fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 藍色或灰色，我們住店就不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gray for me, the blue is too bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ fɔr mi ðə blu ɪz tu braɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我要灰的，藍色太亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the long one, it will drag a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə lɔŋ wʌn ɪt wɪl dræɡ ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 拿長的那件，會稍微拖地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The sleeves are long, my hands vanish.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə slivz ɑr lɔŋ maɪ hændz ˈvænɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 袖子好長，我的手都不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold them once, the belt holds them up.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ðɛm wʌns ðə bɛlt hoʊldz ðɛm ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 摺一次就好，腰帶會抓住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side goes over, left or right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ɡoʊz ˈoʊvɛr lɛft ɔr raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 哪一邊在上面，左還是右？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left under, right over, that is the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft ˈʌndər raɪt ˈoʊvɚ ðæt ɪz ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 左在下、右在上，這樣才對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only sick people wear it the other way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli sɪk ˈpipəl wɛr ɪt ði ˈʌðər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 只有過世的人才反過來穿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, so look at me and copy slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt soʊ lʊk æt mi ænd ˈkɑpi sloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，你看我，慢慢照做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The belt is wide, I need two turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛlt ɪz waɪd aɪ nid tu tɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 腰帶很寬，我要繞兩圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tie it at the back, not on the hips.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪ ɪt æt ðə bæk nɑt ɑn ðə hɪps./
dialogue.zh: 綁在背後，不要綁在腰側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My robe reaches the floor, look at me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ roʊb ˈritʃɪz ðə flɔr lʊk æt mi./
dialogue.zh: 我的浴衣快到地板了，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect length for the bath, walk short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfəkt lɛŋθ fɔr ðə bæθ wɔk ʃɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 泡湯穿剛剛好，步子小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper socks are here in a bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpər sɑks ɑr hɪr ɪn ə bæɡ./
dialogue.zh: 紙襪就在這個袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New ones every day, soft on the feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu wʌnz ˈɛvri deɪ sɔft ɑn ðə fit./
dialogue.zh: 每天都換新的，踩起來很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the mirror, my hair looks so flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈmɪrər maɪ hɛr lʊks soʊ flæt./
dialogue.zh: 現在照鏡子，我的頭髮好扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fluff it, the robe does the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /flʌf ɪt ðə roʊb dʌz ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 抓鬆一點，穿上浴衣就對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down the hall, the lounge with the mats.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ðə hɔl ðə lʊndʒ wɪð ðə mæts./
dialogue.zh: 沿著走廊，就是那個有墊子的休息廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoes off at the step, in your socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃuz ɑf æt ðə stɛp ɪn jɔr sɑks./
dialogue.zh: 在階梯那裡脫鞋，穿著襪子進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The floor smells like dry grass and wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə flɔr smɛlz laɪk draɪ ɡræs ænd wʊd./
dialogue.zh: 地板聞起來像乾草和木頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tatami, they change it every summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈtæmi ðeɪ tʃeɪndʒ ɪt ˈɛvri ˈsʌmər./
dialogue.zh: 那是榻榻米，他們每年夏天都換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This corner seat has the whole window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkɔrnər sit hæz ðə hoʊl ˈwɪnˌdoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 這個角落的位置面對整個窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, my legs want the floor now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn maɪ lɛɡz wɑnt ðə flɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 坐下來，我的腿現在只想著地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cushion, a low table, and a menu.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkʊʃən ə loʊ ˈteɪbəl ænd ə ˈmɛnu./
dialogue.zh: 一個坐墊、一張矮桌，還有一份菜單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No menu here, the board is on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈmɛnu hɪr ðə bɔrd ɪz ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 這裡沒有菜單，價格在牆上的板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green tea is fifty, one small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ti ɪz ˈfɪfti wʌn smɔl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 綠茶五十元，一小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cups, and the eggs are sixty.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu kʌps ænd ði ɛɡz ɑr ˈsɪksti./
dialogue.zh: 兩杯，然後溫泉蛋六十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty for three eggs, that is good math.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti fɔr θri ɛɡz ðæt ɪz ɡʊd mæθ./
dialogue.zh: 三顆六十元，這個算得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three eggs, so one each, and one left.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ɛɡz soʊ wʌn itʃ ænd wʌn lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 三顆蛋，所以一人一顆，還多一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cakes are seventy, three on a plate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə keɪks ɑr ˈsɛvnti θri ɑn ə pleɪt./
dialogue.zh: 點心粿七十元，一盤三顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice cakes, chewy, with sweet bean inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs keɪks ˈtʃui wɪθ swit bin ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 米做的粿，很黏，裡面是紅豆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the red bean soup is ninety.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə rɛd bin sup ɪz ˈnaɪnti./
dialogue.zh: 紅豆湯是九十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm soup in the afternoon, yes, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm sup ɪn ði ˌæftərˈnuːn jɛs pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 下午喝熱湯，好，再來一碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tea, eggs, cakes and soup: three hundred twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ɛɡz keɪks ænd sup θri ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 茶、蛋、粿和湯：三百二十元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hundred twenty, I counted the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈhʌndrəd ˈtwɛnti aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd ðə seɪm./
dialogue.zh: 三百二十元，我算的也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea lady brings a small brown pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti ˈleɪdi brɪŋz ə smɔl braʊn pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 倒茶的小姐拿了一個小壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She pours for us, we hold our cups.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pɔrz fɔr ʌs wi hoʊld ˈaʊər kʌps./
dialogue.zh: 她幫我們倒，我們自己扶著杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tea is bitter, my face must show it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ti ɪz ˈbɪtɚ maɪ feɪs məst ʃoʊ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 茶是苦的，我臉上一定看得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hide it, the soup is sweeter, look.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪd ɪt ðə sup ɪz ˈswitər lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 別表現出來，湯比較甜，你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One egg each, the last one for later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɛɡ itʃ ðə læst wʌn fɔr ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 一人一顆，最後一顆留著等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shell has a gray line all around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛl hæz ə ɡre laɪn ɔl əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 蛋殼周圍有一圈灰色的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That line is the sulfur, not the egg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn ɪz ðə ˈsʌlfər nɑt ði ɛɡ./
dialogue.zh: 那條線是硫磺，不是雞蛋的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the spring cooked it, shell and all.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə sprɪŋ kʊkt ɪt ʃɛl ænd ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 所以是泉水把它煮熟的，連殼一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half boiled, the middle still moves a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf bɔld ðə ˈmɪdəl stɪl muvz ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 半熟，中間還會動一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dip it in the soy, do not shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪp ɪt ɪn ðə sɔɪ du nɑt ʃeɪk./
dialogue.zh: 蘸一下醬油，不要搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are sticky from the rice cake.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑr ˈstɪki frʌm ðə raɪs keɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我的手指被米粿黏住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chewy and sweet, the tea takes that off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃui ænd swit ðə ti teɪks ðæt ɑf./
dialogue.zh: 又黏又甜，喝茶就解掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two men read papers in the far corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɛn rid ˈpeɪpərz ɪn ðə fɑr ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 兩位先生在最裡面看報紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One of them snores like the bench man.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn əv ðɛm snɔrz laɪk ðə bɛntʃ mæn./
dialogue.zh: 其中一位打呼打得像早上長椅那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we be quiet, or is snoring fine?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi bi ˈkwaɪət ɔr ɪz ˈsnɔrɪŋ faɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要安靜嗎，還是打呼沒關係？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, snoring is part of the quiet place.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ˈsnɔrɪŋ ɪz pɑrt əv ðə ˈkwaɪət pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，打呼也是安靜的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A woman looked at my arm just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈwʊmən lʊkt æt maɪ ɑrm dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 剛剛有一位女士一直在看我的手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your tattoo? What did she say about it?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr tæˈtu wʌt dɪd ʃi seɪ əˈbaʊt ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 你的刺青嗎？她說了些什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked if I got it near here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt ɪf aɪ ɡɑt ɪt nɪr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她問我是不是在這一帶刺的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And what did you tell her, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌt dɪd ju tɛl hɜr ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 那妳怎麼回答她的，具體說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I said my uncle has a bigger one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛd maɪ ˈʌŋkəl hæz ə ˈbɪɡər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我說我舅舅有一個更大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She laughed, and then she showed her own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi læft ænd ðɛn ʃi ʃod hɜr on./
dialogue.zh: 她笑了，然後給我看她自己的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a big one a problem in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə bɪɡ wʌn ə ˈprɑbləm ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 面積大的在這裡會是問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sign says cover it, or ask first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə saɪn sɛz ˈkʌvər ɪt ɔr æsk fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 牌子上寫要蓋住，或是先問。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We asked at the desk, and they said yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi æskt æt ðə dɛsk ænd ðeɪ sɛd jɛs./
dialogue.zh: 我們早上問過櫃檯，他們說可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So small ones are fine, and you know it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ smɔl wʌnz ɑr faɪn ænd ju noʊ ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 所以小圖沒關係，你自己知道就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a box for phones on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɑks fɔr foʊnz ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 牆上有一個放手機的格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it there and charge it, no money.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ðɛr ænd tʃɑrdʒ ɪt noʊ ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 放那邊充電，不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five o'clock, the light is going gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv əˈklɑk ðə laɪt ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɡold./
dialogue.zh: 五點了，光線變成金黃色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mountain turns orange for ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmaʊntən tɜrnz ˈɔrɪndʒ fɔr tɛn ˈmɪnəts./
dialogue.zh: 山會變成橘色，只有十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we sleep ten minutes on this mat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi slip tɛn ˈmɪnəts ɑn ðɪs mæt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在這條墊子上睡十分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten only, the dinner bell rings at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈoʊnli ðə ˈdɪnər bɛl rɪŋz æt sɪks./
dialogue.zh: 只能十分鐘，六點會響鈴叫我們去吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If we sleep now, dinner will feel late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf wi slip naʊ ˈdɪnər wɪl fil leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 如果現在睡，晚餐就會覺得太晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So stay awake, I will talk about the fish.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ steɪ əˈweɪ aɪ wɪl tɔk əˈbaʊt ðə fɪʃ./
dialogue.zh: 所以別睡，我來講魚的那一盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fish, rice, soup, greens, and small pickles.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪʃ raɪs sup ɡrinz ænd smɔl ˈpɪkəlz./
dialogue.zh: 魚、飯、湯、青菜，還有小醬菜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the tofu here is made in this house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈtoʊfu hɪr ɪz meɪd ɪn ðɪs haʊs./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的豆腐是他們自己做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is our dinner table, the low one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ˈaʊər ˈdɪnər ˈteɪbəl ðə loʊ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的晚餐桌子在哪裡，矮的那張？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second hall, near the door, table nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd hɔl nɪr ðə dɔr ˈteɪbəl naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 第二個廳，靠近門，九號桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six sharp, we walk there in our slippers.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ʃɑrp wi wɔk ðɛr ɪn ˈaʊər ˈslɪpərz./
dialogue.zh: 六點整，我們穿著拖鞋走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Robe on, hair down, shoes at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊb ɑn hɛr daʊn ʃuz æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 浴衣穿好，頭髮放下，鞋脫在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The eggs are gone, the last one was mine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛɡz ɑr ɡɑn ðə læst wʌn wəz maɪn./
dialogue.zh: 蛋吃完了，最後一顆是我的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You said one for me, I saw you eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju sɛd wʌn fɔr mi aɪ sɔ ju it./
dialogue.zh: 你說過一顆是我的，我親眼看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I will save the cakes for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri aɪ wɪl seɪv ðə keɪks fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我幫你留那幾顆粿。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one, I want the warm bean soup more.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip wʌn aɪ wɑnt ðə wɔrm bin sup mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 留一顆就好，我更想要那碗紅豆湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half past five, the sun is behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf pæst faɪv ðə sʌn ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 五點半，太陽在我們後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we go early, table nine is waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ɡoʊ ˈɜrli ˈteɪbəl naɪn ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那我們早一點過去，九號桌在等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to ask for the bill here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tu æsk fɔr ðə bɪl hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡要自己結帳嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we put the snacks on the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi pʊt ðə snæks ɑn ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 不用，點心直接記到房間的帳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bell rings, dinner starts, let us walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛl rɪŋz ˈdɪnər stɑrts lɛt ʌs wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 鈴響了，晚餐開始，我們走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow steps, the hall is warm and dim.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ stɛps ðə hɔl ɪz wɔrm ænd dɪm./
dialogue.zh: 走慢一點，廳裡很暖、燈光很暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Table nine has our names on a card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈteɪbəl naɪn hæz ˈaʊər nez ɑn ə kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 九號桌上有一張寫我們名字的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two places, low table, soft mat for the legs.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpleɪsɪz loʊ ˈteɪbəl sɔft mæt fɔr ðə lɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 兩個位置，矮桌，腿下面是軟墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees do not like sitting this low.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz du nɑt laɪk ˈsɪtɪŋ ðɪs loʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的膝蓋不喜歡坐這麼低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the chair by the wall, they have some.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə tʃɛr baɪ ðə wɔl ðeɪ hæv sʌm./
dialogue.zh: 用牆邊那張椅子，他們還有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fish came with two small green onions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪʃ keɪm wɪð tu smɔl ɡrin ˈʌnjənz./
dialogue.zh: 魚上面放了兩根小蔥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rice in a black pot, and pickles too.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪs ɪn ə blæk pɑt ænd ˈpɪkəlz tu./
dialogue.zh: 飯裝在黑鍋裡，醬菜也有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six thirty, the room next to us is loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈθɜrti ðə rum nɛkst tu ʌs ɪz laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 六點半，隔壁那一間好吵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids, always kids, they heard the bath bell.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɪdz ˈɔlweɪz kɪdz ðeɪ hɜrd ðə bæθ bɛl./
dialogue.zh: 是小孩，永遠是小孩，他們聽到泡湯的鈴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more soup bowls for the table, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr sup boʊlz fɔr ðə ˈteɪbəl pliːz./
dialogue.zh: 麻煩再拿兩個湯碗到桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a cup for the tea, the hot one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə kʌp fɔr ðə ti ðə hɑt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 再來一個杯子裝熱茶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven forty, back to the room, then bath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ˈfɔrti bæk tu ðə rum ðɛn bæθ./
dialogue.zh: 七點四十，回房間，然後去泡湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes in the warm pool, you promised.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnəts ɪn ðə wɔrm pul ju ˈprɑməst./
dialogue.zh: 溫水池五分鐘，你答應過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight fifty, we go back down the same stairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈfɪfti wi ɡoʊ bæk daʊn ðə seɪm stɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 八點五十，我們再走同樣的樓梯下樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First soak tonight, and only the warm one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst soʊk təˈnaɪt ænd ˈoʊnli ðə wɔrm wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 今晚第一泡，只泡溫的那一池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine ten, the hall is almost empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn tɛn ðə hɔl ɪz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈɛmpti./
dialogue.zh: 現在九點十分，廳裡幾乎沒有人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two men, one light, and no talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɛn wʌn laɪt ænd noʊ ˈtɔkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 兩個男人、一盞燈，沒有人說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our robes and socks, we look like guests.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər roʊbz ænd sɑks wi lʊk laɪk ɡɛsts./
dialogue.zh: 我們穿著浴衣和紙襪，看起來就是房客。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are guests, and the bath is ours now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɑr ɡɛsts ænd ðə bæθ ɪz ˈaʊərz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們就是房客，現在整個湯池是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes tonight, the warm side only.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnəts təˈnaɪt ðə wɔrm saɪd ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 今晚只泡五分鐘，只泡溫的那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty six, so the body can rest first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈθɜrti sɪks soʊ ðə ˈbɑdi kæn rɛst fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 三十六度，身體可以先放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we rinse again before we get in?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi rɪns əˈɡɛn bɪˈfɔr wi ɡɛt ɪn?/
dialogue.zh: 下水之前還要再沖一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just feet and hands, the water is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst fits ænd hændz ðə ˈwɔtər ɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 只沖手腳就好，這裡的水很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water drips slower when it is dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər drɪps ˈsloʊər wɛn ɪt ɪz dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 天一黑，水滴聲聽起來比較慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, one, two, three, there it comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən wʌn tu θri ðɛr ɪt kʌmz./
dialogue.zh: 你聽，一、二、三，它來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In I go, up to my chin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn aɪ ɡoʊ ʌp tu maɪ tʃɪn./
dialogue.zh: 我下水，水到高到下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chin deep in a warm pool at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪn dip ɪn ə wɔrm pul æt naɪt./
dialogue.zh: 晚上在溫水池裡泡到下巴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My skin prickles once, then it stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skɪn ˈprɪkəlz wʌns ðɛn ɪt stɑps./
dialogue.zh: 我的皮膚刺了一下，然後就沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is only the change, not the cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈoʊnli ðə tʃeɪndʒ nɑt ðə koʊld./
dialogue.zh: 那只是溫差的反應，不是著涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can see my toes on the stone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn si maɪ toʊz ɑn ðə stoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我看得見我腳趾靠在石邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stone is dark, your toes look white.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stoʊn ɪz dɑrk jɔr toʊz lʊk waɪt./
dialogue.zh: 石頭是黑的，你的腳趾看起來很白。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One minute down, four are left.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈmɪnɪt daʊn fɔr ɑr lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 過了一分鐘，還剩四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not look at the clock for each one.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lʊk æt ðə klɑk fɔr itʃ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 不要每一分鐘都去看時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This water is so still, no bubbles here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwɔtər ɪz soʊ stɪl noʊ ˈbʌbəlz hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的水完全不動，沒有泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubbles wake you, we want the opposite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz weɪk ju wi wɑnt ði ˈɑpəzət./
dialogue.zh: 氣泡會把人叫醒，我們要的是相反。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My shoulders drop down, I did not know.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz drɑp daʊn aɪ dɪd nɑt noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的肩膀整個沉下去，我自己都不知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They were up by your ears all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɜr ʌp baɪ jɔr ɪrz ɔl deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 它們整個早上都縮到你耳朵旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three minutes, my eyes want to close.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈmɪnəts maɪ aɪz wɑnt tu kloʊz./
dialogue.zh: 三分鐘了，我的眼睛想閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close them, I will count the last two.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðɛm aɪ wɪl kaʊnt ðə læst tu./
dialogue.zh: 閉起來吧，最後兩分鐘我幫你數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Somebody's towel is on the water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmˌbɑdiz ˈtaʊəl ɪz ɑn ðə ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 有個人的毛巾漂在水面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two men saw it and said nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu mɛn sɔ ɪt ænd sɛd ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 那兩個男人都看見了，都沒出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is why we keep towels off water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ wi kip ˈtaʊəlz ɑf ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們才不把毛巾放進水裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The very first rule, and you remembered it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvɛri fɜrst rul ænd ju rɪˈmɛmbərd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 第一條規矩，你居然還記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out at nine seventeen, we made it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt æt naɪn ˌsɛvənˈtin wi meɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 九點十七分上岸，我們做到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes, not six, I counted for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnəts nɑt sɪks aɪ ˈkaʊntɪd fɔr ju./
dialogue.zh: 五分鐘，沒有六分鐘，我幫你數了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Standing up is easy, no garden turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ ʌp ɪz ˈizi noʊ ˈɡɑrdən tɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 站起來很容易，花園沒有在轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that was the scary part today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðæt wəz ðə ˈskɛri pɑrt təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，那是今天最可怕的一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A short rinse for my legs and arms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ʃɔrt rɪns fɔr maɪ lɛɡz ænd ɑrmz./
dialogue.zh: 腿和手快速再沖一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tap is cold, count to twenty fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tæp ɪz koʊld kaʊnt tu ˈtwɛnti fæst./
dialogue.zh: 水龍頭是涼的，快數到二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now dry well, night air is cool here.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ draɪ wɛl naɪt ɛr ɪz kul hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 現在擦乾，晚上的空氣很涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My back is dry, my hair is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ bæk ɪz draɪ maɪ hɛr ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我背擦了，頭髮還沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No milk tonight, warm water for my throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mɪlk təˈnaɪt wɔrm ˈwɔtər fɔr maɪ θroʊt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚不喝牛奶，喝溫水潤喉嚨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the fridge is closed at nine anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə frɪdʒ ɪz kloʊzd æt naɪn ˈɛniˌweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，反正小冰箱九點就關了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shop light is off, the cat is back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑp laɪt ɪz ɑf ðə kæt ɪz bæk./
dialogue.zh: 小賣部的燈關了，那隻貓回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She sleeps on the milk box, poor thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi slips ɑn ðə mɪlk bɑks pʊr θɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她睡在牛奶箱上面，真可憐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In the room, brush teeth, wash the face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə rum brʌʃ tiθ wɑʃ ðə feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 回到房間，刷牙、洗臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two new brushes are in the little cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu nu ˈbrʌʃɪz ɑr ɪn ðə ˈlɪtəl kʌp./
dialogue.zh: 杯子裡有兩支新的牙刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paste is minty, my mouth wakes up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə peɪst ɪz ˈmɪnti maɪ maʊθ weɪks ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 牙膏是薄荷的，我整個嘴巴醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hair dry, then the robe becomes pajamas.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛr draɪ ðɛn ðə roʊb bɪˈkʌz pəˈdʒæməz./
dialogue.zh: 頭髮吹乾，浴衣就當睡衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair is dry, come and look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛr ɪz draɪ kʌm ænd lʊk æt ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我頭髮乾了，你過來看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fluffy now, softer than before the bath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈflʌfi naʊ ˈsɔfər ðæn bɪˈfɔr ðə bæθ./
dialogue.zh: 現在蓬起來了，比泡湯之前還軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slippers in a row, by the door, two pairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpərz ɪn ə roʊ baɪ ðə dɔr tu pɛrz./
dialogue.zh: 拖鞋在門邊排成一排，兩雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point them out, that is how they like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ðɛm aʊt ðæt ɪz haʊ ðeɪ laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 鞋頭朝外擺，他們喜歡這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bed is low, the blanket is heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bɛd ɪz loʊ ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi./
dialogue.zh: 我們的床很低，被子很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good for cold nights, the window stays open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd fɔr koʊld naɪts ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ steɪz ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 適合冷的晚上，窗子要留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave a crack, the spring air comes in.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ə kræk ðə sprɪŋ ɛr kʌmz ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 留一條小縫，溫泉的空氣會進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It smells like eggs, and I love that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt smɛlz laɪk ɛɡz ænd aɪ lʌv ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 聞起來像雞蛋，我很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine forty, we turn the lights down now.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ˈfɔrti wi tɜrn ðə laɪts daʊn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 九點四十，我們把燈轉暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small lamp by the door is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl læmp baɪ ðə dɔr ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 門邊留一小盞燈就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are warm, my hands are warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fits ɑr wɔrm maɪ hændz ɑr wɔrm./
dialogue.zh: 我的腳是暖的，手也是暖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the bath, it works from inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bæθ ɪt wɜrks frʌm ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那就是泡湯的效果，從裡面熱起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me the numbers one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl mi ðə ˈnʌmbərz wʌn mɔr taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 再把那些數字唸給我聽一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three hot rounds, forty five minutes in all.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri hɑt raʊndz ˈfɔrti faɪv ˈmɪnəts ɪn ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 熱水三輪，一共四十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And tonight five, so fifty in the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd təˈnaɪt faɪv soʊ ˈfɪfti ɪn ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 今晚再加五分鐘，一天就是五十分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty, and tomorrow is a new count.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti ænd təˈmɑroʊ ɪz ə nu kaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 五十分，明天重新再算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much did we spend on the stay?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dɪd wi spɛnd ɑn ðə steɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們住這裡一共花多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five thousand two hundred, the tickets were inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈθaʊzənd tu ˈhʌndrəd ðə ˈtɪkəts wɜr ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 五千二百元，早上的票已經折在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk and snacks are on a different paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ænd snæks ɑr ɑn ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 牛奶和點心是在另一張單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two forty for milk, three twenty snacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ˈfɔrti fɔr mɪlk θri ˈtwɛnti snæks./
dialogue.zh: 對，牛奶兩百四，點心三百二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the robe fee, one hundred at noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə roʊb fi wʌn ˈhʌndrəd æt nun./
dialogue.zh: 還有中午那件浴衣一百元。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hundred sixty for those, that is all.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈhʌndrəd ˈsɪksti fɔr ðoz ðæt ɪz ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 那些加起來六百六十元，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do they call us in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm du ðeɪ kɔl ʌs ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 早上幾點會來叫我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six fifty, a knock, then breakfast at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈfɪfti ə nɑk ðɛn ˈbrɛkfəst æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 六點五十敲門，七點吃早餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning bath, who will be in first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ bæθ hu wɪl bi ɪn fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 早上的湯池，誰會先到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old ladies, always, at seven sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊld ˈleɪdiz ˈɔlweɪz æt ˈsɛvən ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 那幾位阿嬤，一定七點整就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get the big pool at eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡɛt ðə bɪɡ pul æt eɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 八點我們可以泡大池嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fifteen minutes at forty two, our rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts æt ˈfɔrti tu ˈaʊər rul./
dialogue.zh: 可以，十五分鐘、四十二度，我們的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the stone pool outside, with the leaves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə stoʊn pul ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɪð ðə livz./
dialogue.zh: 還有外面那個有落葉的岩石池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We take the mat and count our fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi teɪk ðə mæt ænd kaʊnt ˈaʊər ˌfɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 我們帶著墊子下去，自己數十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Checkout is at ten, the bags go down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɛkˌaʊt ɪz æt tɛn ðə bæɡz ɡoʊ daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 退房是十點，行李先拿下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bus back leaves at ten thirty, I saw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʌs bæk livz æt tɛn ˈθɜrti aɪ sɔ./
dialogue.zh: 回程客運十點半開，我看過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So one more bath, then the long bus home.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌn mɔr bæθ ðɛn ðə lɔŋ bʌs hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 所以再泡一次，然後坐長長的巴士回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can sleep on the bus, all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn slip ɑn ðə bʌs ɔl ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在巴士上睡一路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the lamp, my eyes are done.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɑf ðə læmp maɪ aɪz ɑr dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 把小燈關掉，我的眼睛不行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more minute, the mountain is gone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ˈmɪnɪt ðə ˈmaʊntən ɪz ɡɑn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 再一分鐘，山現在看不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dark outside, only the pool light on the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈoʊnli ðə pul laɪt ɑn ðə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 外面是黑的，只有池邊那盞燈在牆上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, the steam moves slow, like it breathes.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə stim muvz sloʊ laɪk ɪt briðz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，蒸氣慢慢動，像在呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My body is heavy, my head is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɑdi ɪz ˈhɛvi maɪ hɛd ɪz nɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我身體很重，腦袋不重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the best sign before sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə bɛst saɪn bɪˈfɔr slip./
dialogue.zh: 那是睡覺前最好的徵象。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the blanket up, my shoulders are cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə ˈblæŋkɪt ʌp maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz ɑr kul./
dialogue.zh: 被子拉上來，我肩膀有點涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the robe smells like soap and spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə roʊb smɛlz laɪk soʊp ænd sprɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 而且浴衣聞起來像肥皂和泉水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear the bamboo one more time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr ðə ˌbæmˈbu wʌn mɔr taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 你聽見那個竹筒又響了一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one, two, and then we stop counting.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn tu ænd ðɛn wi stɑp ˈkaʊntɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 聽到了，一下、兩下，然後我們不再數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six fifty tomorrow, so sleep is now work.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈfɪfti təˈmɑroʊ soʊ slip ɪz naʊ wɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 明天六點五十要起來，所以現在的工作是睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try counting slowly from one to ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ˈkaʊntɪŋ ˈsloʊli frʌm wʌn tu tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 你從一開始，慢慢地數到十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is ten already, I am almost gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz tɛn ɔlˈrɛdi aɪ æm ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 已經十點了，我快要睡過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Except the cleaner, he works after ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈsɛpt ðə ˈklənər hi wɜrks ˈæftər tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 只有打掃的人，他十點之後才開工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Baths close at ten, nobody is inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæθz kloʊz æt tɛn ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd./
dialogue.zh: 十點泡湯關門，裡面已經沒人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, tomorrow the water waits for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ təˈmɑroʊ ðə ˈwɔtər weɪts fɔr ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，明天的水會等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the window, a small crack.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ə smɔl kræk./
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，窗子留一條小縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the cold air is on your face.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðə koʊld ɛr ɪz ɑn jɔr feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好了，涼的空氣正吹在你臉上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep well, and thank you for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl ænd θæŋk ju fɔr təˈdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，今天真的謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, dream of forty two degrees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt drim əv ˈfɔrti tu dɪˈɡriz./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，夢到四十二度的水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes more, but only in my head.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnəts mɔr bʌt ˈoʊnli ɪn maɪ hɛd./
dialogue.zh: 再泡五分鐘，但只在我的腦袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep, the spring will still be here at seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ðə sprɪŋ wɪl stɪl bi hɪr æt ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，七點的時候泉水還在這裡。
